13def freeze_cohort(cache, previous_cache, output, count=10000, seed=3107):
14    data, previous = PreparedData(cache), PreparedData(previous_cache)
15    excluded = previous.user_rids[previous.eval_indices]
16    eligible = np.flatnonzero(~np.isin(data.user_rids, excluded))
17    if len(eligible) < count:
18        raise ValueError('Not enough fresh evaluation users.')
19    selected = np.sort(np.random.default_rng(seed).choice(eligible, count, replace=False)).astype(np.int64)
20    output = Path(output)
21    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
22    if output.exists():
23        np.testing.assert_array_equal(np.load(output), selected)
24    else:
25        np.save(output, selected)
26    assert not np.isin(data.user_rids[selected], excluded).any()
27    description = dict(cache=str(Path(cache).resolve()), users=count, seed=seed,
28                       excluded_previous_test_users=len(excluded), overlap_with_previous_test_users=0,
29                       indices_sha256=hashlib.sha256(selected.tobytes()).hexdigest(),
30                       role='validation selects epoch; later test clicks remain unopened until objective is locked')
31    output.with_suffix('.json').write_text(json.dumps(description, indent=2) + '\n')
32    return description
33
34
35if __name__ == '__main__':
36    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
37    parser.add_argument('--cache', required=True)
38    parser.add_argument('--previous-cache', default='artifacts/baseline/data')
39    parser.add_argument('--output', required=True)
40    parser.add_argument('--users', type=int, default=10000)
41    parser.add_argument('--seed', type=int, default=3107)
42    args = parser.parse_args()
43    print(json.dumps(freeze_cohort(args.cache, args.previous_cache, args.output, args.users, args.seed), indent=2))

3import json
4from pathlib import Path
5
6import numpy as np
7import torch
8from torch.utils.data import Dataset
9
10
11def load_array(root, name):
12    return np.load(Path(root) / f'{name}.npy', mmap_mode='c', allow_pickle=False)
13
14
15class PreparedData:
16    def __init__(self, root):
17        self.root = Path(root)
18        self.metadata = json.loads((self.root / 'metadata.json').read_text())
19        for name in ['items', 'actions', 'timestamps', 'user_rids', 'lengths',
20                     'train_cut', 'val_cut', 'test_cut', 'val_pos', 'test_pos',
21                     'train_counts', 'eval_indices', 'catalog_rids', 'catalog_oids']:
22            setattr(self, name, load_array(root, name))
23        self.max_history = self.items.shape[1]
24        self.num_users = len(self.items)
25        self.num_items = len(self.catalog_rids) - 1
26
27    def set_eval_indices(self, indices):
28        indices = np.asarray(indices, dtype=np.int64)
29        if (indices.ndim != 1 or not len(indices) or len(np.unique(indices)) != len(indices)
30                or indices.min() < 0 or indices.max() >= self.num_users):
31            raise ValueError('Invalid evaluation cohort indices.')
32        self.eval_indices = indices
33
34
35def make_input(items, actions, max_history):
36    """Left-pad history, retaining an explicit user token and the last event."""
37    items, actions = np.asarray(items)[-max_history:], np.asarray(actions)[-max_history:]
38    length = max_history + 1
39    start = length - len(items) - 1
40    seq = np.zeros(length, dtype=np.int64)
41    kinds = np.zeros(length, dtype=np.int64)
42    acts = np.zeros(length, dtype=np.int64)
43    kinds[start] = 2
44    seq[start + 1:] = items
45    kinds[start + 1:] = 1
46    acts[start + 1:] = actions
47    return seq, kinds, acts
48
49
50class SequenceDataset(Dataset):
51    def __init__(self, data, split='train'):
52        if split not in ['train', 'val', 'test']:
53            raise ValueError(split)
54        self.data, self.split = data, split
55        self.indices = np.arange(data.num_users) if split == 'train' else data.eval_indices
56
57    def __len__(self):
58        return len(self.indices)
59
60    def __getitem__(self, index):
61        row = int(self.indices[index])
62        data = self.data
63        cut = int(getattr(data, f'{self.split}_cut')[row])
64        prefix = data.items[row, :cut]
65        acts = data.actions[row, :cut]
66        if self.split == 'train':
67            seq, kinds, actions = make_input(prefix[:-1], acts[:-1], data.max_history)
68            pos = np.zeros(data.max_history + 1, dtype=np.int64)
69            pos_actions = np.zeros_like(pos)
70            pos[-cut:] = prefix
71            pos_actions[-cut:] = acts
72            return dict(user=row + 1, row=row, items=seq, kinds=kinds, actions=actions,
73                        positive=pos, target_actions=pos_actions,
74                        seen=np.pad(prefix, (0, data.max_history - len(prefix))).astype(np.int64))
75        seq, kinds, actions = make_input(prefix, acts, data.max_history)
76        target = int(data.items[row, getattr(data, f'{self.split}_pos')[row]])
77        return dict(user=row + 1, row=row, items=seq, kinds=kinds, actions=actions, target=target)
78
79
80def sample_negatives(pool, seen, shape, generator):
81    """Reject training-prefix items only; never consult held-out targets."""
82    if pool.numel() <= seen.shape[1] and any(
83            torch.isin(pool, history).all().item() for history in seen):
84        raise ValueError('Negative pool is fully covered by a user history.')
85    negative = pool[torch.randint(len(pool), shape, device=pool.device, generator=generator)]
86    for _ in range(100):
87        conflict = (negative.unsqueeze(-1) == seen.unsqueeze(1)).any(-1)
88        if not conflict.any():
89            return negative
90        negative[conflict] = pool[torch.randint(len(pool), (int(conflict.sum()),),
91                                              device=pool.device, generator=generator)]
92    raise RuntimeError('Negative rejection sampling did not converge.')

1"""Vectorized SASRec-style baseline and a controlled history-action ablation.
2
3The attention and feed-forward blocks come from the supplied baseline. Both
4variants share the same encoders, initialization, positions and training loss;
5the action variant additionally sums an embedding of each observed past action.
6"""
7
8import math
9
10import numpy as np
11import torch
12from torch import nn
13
14from model import FlashMultiHeadAttention, PointWiseFeedForward
15from .data import load_array
16
17
18class SequenceRetriever(nn.Module):
19    def __init__(self, data, hidden=32, blocks=1, heads=1, dropout=0.2, use_actions=False):
20        super().__init__()
21        self.use_actions = use_actions
22        self.hidden = hidden
23        meta = data.metadata
24        self.item_fields, self.user_fields = meta['item_fields'], meta['user_fields']
25        self.array_fields = meta['user_array_fields']
26        for name in ['item_sparse', 'item_mm81', 'user_sparse', 'item_id_lookup']:
27            self.register_buffer(name, torch.from_numpy(load_array(data.root, name)), persistent=False)
28        for field in self.array_fields:
29            self.register_buffer(f'user_array_{field}', torch.from_numpy(
30                load_array(data.root, f'user_array_{field}')), persistent=False)
31        self.item_emb = nn.Embedding(int(self.item_id_lookup.max()) + 1, hidden, padding_idx=0)
32        self.user_emb = nn.Embedding(data.num_users + 1, hidden, padding_idx=0)
33        self.sparse_emb = nn.ModuleDict({field: nn.Embedding(meta['feature_sizes'][field], hidden, padding_idx=0)
34                                        for field in self.item_fields + self.user_fields + self.array_fields})
35        self.mm_projection = nn.Linear(32, hidden)
36        self.item_dnn = nn.Linear(hidden * (len(self.item_fields) + 2), hidden)
37        self.user_dnn = nn.Linear(hidden * (1 + len(self.user_fields) + len(self.array_fields)), hidden)
38        self.position_emb = nn.Embedding(data.max_history + 2, hidden, padding_idx=0)
39        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
40        self.attention = nn.ModuleList([FlashMultiHeadAttention(hidden, heads, dropout) for _ in range(blocks)])
41        self.ffn = nn.ModuleList([PointWiseFeedForward(hidden, dropout) for _ in range(blocks)])
42        self.norm_attn = nn.ModuleList([nn.LayerNorm(hidden, eps=1e-8) for _ in range(blocks)])
43        self.norm_ffn = nn.ModuleList([nn.LayerNorm(hidden, eps=1e-8) for _ in range(blocks)])
44        self.final_norm = nn.LayerNorm(hidden, eps=1e-8)
45        # Allocate in both variants so every shared parameter has identical RNG initialization.
46        self.action_emb = nn.Embedding(4, hidden, padding_idx=0)
47        self.apply(self._initialize)
48
49    @staticmethod
50    def _initialize(module):
51        if isinstance(module, (nn.Embedding, nn.Linear)):
52            nn.init.xavier_normal_(module.weight)
53            if isinstance(module, nn.Embedding) and module.padding_idx is not None:
54                with torch.no_grad():
55                    module.weight[module.padding_idx].zero_()
56            if isinstance(module, nn.Linear) and module.bias is not None:
57                nn.init.zeros_(module.bias)
58
59    def encode_items(self, ids):
60        lookup = self.item_id_lookup[ids]
61        parts = [self.item_emb(lookup)]
62        sparse = self.item_sparse[ids]
63        parts.extend(self.sparse_emb[field](sparse[..., j]) for j, field in enumerate(self.item_fields))
64        parts.append(self.mm_projection(self.item_mm81[ids]))
65        result = torch.relu(self.item_dnn(torch.cat(parts, dim=-1)))
66        return result * (ids != 0).unsqueeze(-1)
67
68    def encode_users(self, ids):
69        parts = [self.user_emb(ids)]
70        sparse = self.user_sparse[ids]
71        parts.extend(self.sparse_emb[field](sparse[..., j]) for j, field in enumerate(self.user_fields))
72        parts.extend(self.sparse_emb[field](getattr(self, f'user_array_{field}')[ids]).sum(-2)
73                     for field in self.array_fields)
74        return torch.relu(self.user_dnn(torch.cat(parts, dim=-1)))
75
76    def encode_history(self, items, kinds, actions, users):
77        item_mask, user_mask, valid = kinds == 1, kinds == 2, kinds != 0
78        hidden = self.encode_items(items) * item_mask.unsqueeze(-1)
79        hidden = hidden + self.encode_users(users).unsqueeze(1) * user_mask.unsqueeze(-1)
80        if self.use_actions:
81            hidden = hidden + self.action_emb(actions) * item_mask.unsqueeze(-1)
82        positions = valid.long().cumsum(1) * valid
83        hidden = self.dropout(hidden * math.sqrt(self.hidden) + self.position_emb(positions))
84        hidden = hidden * valid.unsqueeze(-1)
85        length = items.shape[1]
86        causal = torch.ones(length, length, dtype=torch.bool, device=items.device).tril()
87        allowed = causal.unsqueeze(0) & valid.unsqueeze(1)
88        # Padded queries attend to themselves only, avoiding fully masked softmax rows.
89        allowed = allowed | ((~valid).unsqueeze(-1) & torch.eye(
90            length, dtype=torch.bool, device=items.device).unsqueeze(0))
91        for attention, ffn, norm_a, norm_f in zip(self.attention, self.ffn, self.norm_attn, self.norm_ffn):
92            residual, _ = attention(hidden, hidden, hidden, attn_mask=allowed)
93            hidden = norm_a(hidden + residual)
94            hidden = norm_f(hidden + ffn(hidden)) * valid.unsqueeze(-1)
95        return self.final_norm(hidden) * valid.unsqueeze(-1)
96
97    def forward(self, batch, negative):
98        states = self.encode_history(batch['items'], batch['kinds'], batch['actions'], batch['user'])
99        return ((states * self.encode_items(batch['positive'])).sum(-1),
100                (states * self.encode_items(negative)).sum(-1))
101
102    def predict(self, batch):
103        return self.encode_history(batch['items'], batch['kinds'], batch['actions'], batch['user'])[:, -1]

1from pathlib import Path
2
3import numpy as np
4import torch
5import torch.nn.functional as F
6from tqdm import tqdm
7
8from dataset import save_emb
9
10
11class FlashMultiHeadAttention(torch.nn.Module):
12    def __init__(self, hidden_units, num_heads, dropout_rate):
13        super(FlashMultiHeadAttention, self).__init__()
14
15        self.hidden_units = hidden_units
16        self.num_heads = num_heads
17        self.head_dim = hidden_units // num_heads
18        self.dropout_rate = dropout_rate
19
20        assert hidden_units % num_heads == 0, "hidden_units must be divisible by num_heads"
21
22        self.q_linear = torch.nn.Linear(hidden_units, hidden_units)
23        self.k_linear = torch.nn.Linear(hidden_units, hidden_units)
24        self.v_linear = torch.nn.Linear(hidden_units, hidden_units)
25        self.out_linear = torch.nn.Linear(hidden_units, hidden_units)
26
27    def forward(self, query, key, value, attn_mask=None):
28        batch_size, seq_len, _ = query.size()
29
30        # 计算Q, K, V
31        Q = self.q_linear(query)
32        K = self.k_linear(key)
33        V = self.v_linear(value)
34
35        # reshape为multi-head格式
36        Q = Q.view(batch_size, seq_len, self.num_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
37        K = K.view(batch_size, seq_len, self.num_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
38        V = V.view(batch_size, seq_len, self.num_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
39
40        if hasattr(F, 'scaled_dot_product_attention'):
41            # PyTorch 2.0+ 使用内置的Flash Attention
42            attn_output = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(
43                Q, K, V, dropout_p=self.dropout_rate if self.training else 0.0, attn_mask=attn_mask.unsqueeze(1)
44            )
45        else:
46            # 降级到标准注意力机制
47            scale = (self.head_dim) ** -0.5
48            scores = torch.matmul(Q, K.transpose(-2, -1)) * scale
49
50            if attn_mask is not None:
51                scores.masked_fill_(attn_mask.unsqueeze(1).logical_not(), float('-inf'))
52
53            attn_weights = F.softmax(scores, dim=-1)
54            attn_weights = F.dropout(attn_weights, p=self.dropout_rate, training=self.training)
55            attn_output = torch.matmul(attn_weights, V)
56
57        # reshape回原来的格式
58        attn_output = attn_output.transpose(1, 2).contiguous().view(batch_size, seq_len, self.hidden_units)
59
60        # 最终的线性变换
61        output = self.out_linear(attn_output)
62
63        return output, None
64
65
66class PointWiseFeedForward(torch.nn.Module):
67    def __init__(self, hidden_units, dropout_rate):
68        super(PointWiseFeedForward, self).__init__()
69
70        self.conv1 = torch.nn.Conv1d(hidden_units, hidden_units, kernel_size=1)
71        self.dropout1 = torch.nn.Dropout(p=dropout_rate)
72        self.relu = torch.nn.ReLU()
73        self.conv2 = torch.nn.Conv1d(hidden_units, hidden_units, kernel_size=1)
74        self.dropout2 = torch.nn.Dropout(p=dropout_rate)
75
76    def forward(self, inputs):
77        outputs = self.dropout2(self.conv2(self.relu(self.dropout1(self.conv1(inputs.transpose(-1, -2))))))
78        outputs = outputs.transpose(-1, -2)  # as Conv1D requires (N, C, Length)
79        return outputs
80
81
82class BaselineModel(torch.nn.Module):
83    """
84    Args:
85        user_num: 用户数量
86        item_num: 物品数量
87        feat_statistics: 特征统计信息，key为特征ID，value为特征数量
88        feat_types: 各个特征的特征类型，key为特征类型名称，value为包含的特征ID列表，包括user和item的sparse, array, emb, continual类型
89        args: 全局参数
90
91    Attributes:
92        user_num: 用户数量
93        item_num: 物品数量
94        dev: 设备
95        norm_first: 是否先归一化
96        maxlen: 序列最大长度
97        item_emb: Item Embedding Table
98        user_emb: User Embedding Table
99        sparse_emb: 稀疏特征Embedding Table
100        emb_transform: 多模态特征的线性变换
101        userdnn: 用户特征拼接后经过的全连接层
102        itemdnn: 物品特征拼接后经过的全连接层
103    """
104
105    def __init__(self, user_num, item_num, feat_statistics, feat_types, args):  #
106        super(BaselineModel, self).__init__()
107
108        self.user_num = user_num
109        self.item_num = item_num
110        self.dev = args.device
111        self.norm_first = args.norm_first
112        self.maxlen = args.maxlen
113        # TODO: loss += args.l2_emb for regularizing embedding vectors during training
114        # https://stackoverflow.com/questions/42704283/adding-l1-l2-regularization-in-pytorch
115
116        self.item_emb = torch.nn.Embedding(self.item_num + 1, args.hidden_units, padding_idx=0)
117        self.user_emb = torch.nn.Embedding(self.user_num + 1, args.hidden_units, padding_idx=0)
118        self.pos_emb = torch.nn.Embedding(2 * args.maxlen + 1, args.hidden_units, padding_idx=0)
119        self.emb_dropout = torch.nn.Dropout(p=args.dropout_rate)
120        self.sparse_emb = torch.nn.ModuleDict()
121        self.emb_transform = torch.nn.ModuleDict()
122
123        self.attention_layernorms = torch.nn.ModuleList()  # to be Q for self-attention
124        self.attention_layers = torch.nn.ModuleList()
125        self.forward_layernorms = torch.nn.ModuleList()
126        self.forward_layers = torch.nn.ModuleList()
127
128        self._init_feat_info(feat_statistics, feat_types)
129
130        userdim = args.hidden_units * (len(self.USER_SPARSE_FEAT) + 1 + len(self.USER_ARRAY_FEAT)) + len(
131            self.USER_CONTINUAL_FEAT
132        )
133        itemdim = (
134            args.hidden_units * (len(self.ITEM_SPARSE_FEAT) + 1 + len(self.ITEM_ARRAY_FEAT))
135            + len(self.ITEM_CONTINUAL_FEAT)
136            + args.hidden_units * len(self.ITEM_EMB_FEAT)
137        )
138
139        self.userdnn = torch.nn.Linear(userdim, args.hidden_units)
140        self.itemdnn = torch.nn.Linear(itemdim, args.hidden_units)
141
142        self.last_layernorm = torch.nn.LayerNorm(args.hidden_units, eps=1e-8)
143
144        for _ in range(args.num_blocks):
145            new_attn_layernorm = torch.nn.LayerNorm(args.hidden_units, eps=1e-8)
146            self.attention_layernorms.append(new_attn_layernorm)
147
148            new_attn_layer = FlashMultiHeadAttention(
149                args.hidden_units, args.num_heads, args.dropout_rate
150            )  # 优化：用FlashAttention替代标准Attention
151            self.attention_layers.append(new_attn_layer)
152
153            new_fwd_layernorm = torch.nn.LayerNorm(args.hidden_units, eps=1e-8)
154            self.forward_layernorms.append(new_fwd_layernorm)
155
156            new_fwd_layer = PointWiseFeedForward(args.hidden_units, args.dropout_rate)
157            self.forward_layers.append(new_fwd_layer)
158
159        for k in self.USER_SPARSE_FEAT:
160            self.sparse_emb[k] = torch.nn.Embedding(self.USER_SPARSE_FEAT[k] + 1, args.hidden_units, padding_idx=0)
161        for k in self.ITEM_SPARSE_FEAT:
162            self.sparse_emb[k] = torch.nn.Embedding(self.ITEM_SPARSE_FEAT[k] + 1, args.hidden_units, padding_idx=0)
163        for k in self.ITEM_ARRAY_FEAT:
164            self.sparse_emb[k] = torch.nn.Embedding(self.ITEM_ARRAY_FEAT[k] + 1, args.hidden_units, padding_idx=0)
165        for k in self.USER_ARRAY_FEAT:
166            self.sparse_emb[k] = torch.nn.Embedding(self.USER_ARRAY_FEAT[k] + 1, args.hidden_units, padding_idx=0)
167        for k in self.ITEM_EMB_FEAT:
168            self.emb_transform[k] = torch.nn.Linear(self.ITEM_EMB_FEAT[k], args.hidden_units)
169
170    def _init_feat_info(self, feat_statistics, feat_types):
171        """
172        将特征统计信息（特征数量）按特征类型分组产生不同的字典，方便声明稀疏特征的Embedding Table
173
174        Args:
175            feat_statistics: 特征统计信息，key为特征ID，value为特征数量
176            feat_types: 各个特征的特征类型，key为特征类型名称，value为包含的特征ID列表，包括user和item的sparse, array, emb, continual类型
177        """
178        self.USER_SPARSE_FEAT = {k: feat_statistics[k] for k in feat_types['user_sparse']}
179        self.USER_CONTINUAL_FEAT = feat_types['user_continual']
180        self.ITEM_SPARSE_FEAT = {k: feat_statistics[k] for k in feat_types['item_sparse']}
181        self.ITEM_CONTINUAL_FEAT = feat_types['item_continual']
182        self.USER_ARRAY_FEAT = {k: feat_statistics[k] for k in feat_types['user_array']}
183        self.ITEM_ARRAY_FEAT = {k: feat_statistics[k] for k in feat_types['item_array']}
184        EMB_SHAPE_DICT = {"81": 32, "82": 1024, "83": 3584, "84": 4096, "85": 3584, "86": 3584}
185        self.ITEM_EMB_FEAT = {k: EMB_SHAPE_DICT[k] for k in feat_types['item_emb']}  # 记录的是不同多模态特征的维度
186
187    def feat2tensor(self, seq_feature, k):
188        """
189        Args:
190            seq_feature: 序列特征list，每个元素为当前时刻的特征字典，形状为 [batch_size, maxlen]
191            k: 特征ID
192
193        Returns:
194            batch_data: 特征值的tensor，形状为 [batch_size, maxlen, max_array_len(if array)]
195        """
196        batch_size = len(seq_feature)
197
198        if k in self.ITEM_ARRAY_FEAT or k in self.USER_ARRAY_FEAT:
199            # 如果特征是Array类型，需要先对array进行padding，然后转换为tensor
200            max_array_len = 0
201            max_seq_len = 0
202
203            for i in range(batch_size):
204                seq_data = [item[k] for item in seq_feature[i]]
205                max_seq_len = max(max_seq_len, len(seq_data))
206                max_array_len = max(max_array_len, max(len(item_data) for item_data in seq_data))
207
208            batch_data = np.zeros((batch_size, max_seq_len, max_array_len), dtype=np.int64)
209            for i in range(batch_size):
210                seq_data = [item[k] for item in seq_feature[i]]
211                for j, item_data in enumerate(seq_data):
212                    actual_len = min(len(item_data), max_array_len)
213                    batch_data[i, j, :actual_len] = item_data[:actual_len]
214
215            return torch.from_numpy(batch_data).to(self.dev)
216        else:
217            # 如果特征是Sparse类型，直接转换为tensor
218            max_seq_len = max(len(seq_feature[i]) for i in range(batch_size))
219            batch_data = np.zeros((batch_size, max_seq_len), dtype=np.int64)
220
221            for i in range(batch_size):
222                seq_data = [item[k] for item in seq_feature[i]]
223                batch_data[i] = seq_data
224
225            return torch.from_numpy(batch_data).to(self.dev)
226
227    def feat2emb(self, seq, feature_array, mask=None, include_user=False):
228        """
229        Args:
230            seq: 序列ID
231            feature_array: 特征list，每个元素为当前时刻的特征字典
232            mask: 掩码，1表示item，2表示user
233            include_user: 是否处理用户特征，在两种情况下不打开：1) 训练时在转换正负样本的特征时（因为正负样本都是item）;2) 生成候选库item embedding时。
234
235        Returns:
236            seqs_emb: 序列特征的Embedding
237        """
238        seq = seq.to(self.dev)
239        # pre-compute embedding
240        if include_user:
241            user_mask = (mask == 2).to(self.dev)
242            item_mask = (mask == 1).to(self.dev)
243            user_embedding = self.user_emb(user_mask * seq)
244            item_embedding = self.item_emb(item_mask * seq)
245            item_feat_list = [item_embedding]
246            user_feat_list = [user_embedding]
247        else:
248            item_embedding = self.item_emb(seq)
249            item_feat_list = [item_embedding]
250
251        # batch-process all feature types
252        all_feat_types = [
253            (self.ITEM_SPARSE_FEAT, 'item_sparse', item_feat_list),
254            (self.ITEM_ARRAY_FEAT, 'item_array', item_feat_list),
255            (self.ITEM_CONTINUAL_FEAT, 'item_continual', item_feat_list),
256        ]
257
258        if include_user:
259            all_feat_types.extend(
260                [
261                    (self.USER_SPARSE_FEAT, 'user_sparse', user_feat_list),
262                    (self.USER_ARRAY_FEAT, 'user_array', user_feat_list),
263                    (self.USER_CONTINUAL_FEAT, 'user_continual', user_feat_list),
264                ]
265            )
266
267        # batch-process each feature type
268        # print("Start processing features to embeddings...")
269        for feat_dict, feat_type, feat_list in all_feat_types:
270            if not feat_dict:
271                continue
272
273            for k in feat_dict:
274                tensor_feature = self.feat2tensor(feature_array, k)
275
276                if feat_type.endswith('sparse'):
277                    feat_list.append(self.sparse_emb[k](tensor_feature))
278                elif feat_type.endswith('array'):
279                    feat_list.append(self.sparse_emb[k](tensor_feature).sum(2))
280                elif feat_type.endswith('continual'):
281                    feat_list.append(tensor_feature.unsqueeze(2))
282
283        # print(f"len(self.ITEM_EMB_FEAT) keys: {self.ITEM_EMB_FEAT.keys()}")
284        for k in self.ITEM_EMB_FEAT:
285            # collect all data to numpy, then batch-convert
286            batch_size = len(feature_array)
287            emb_dim = self.ITEM_EMB_FEAT[k]
288            seq_len = len(feature_array[0])
289
290            # pre-allocate tensor
291            batch_emb_data = np.zeros((batch_size, seq_len, emb_dim), dtype=np.float32)
292
293            for i, seq in enumerate(feature_array):
294                for j, item in enumerate(seq):
295                    if k in item:
296                        batch_emb_data[i, j] = item[k]
297
298            # batch-convert and transfer to GPU
299            tensor_feature = torch.from_numpy(batch_emb_data).to(self.dev)
300            item_feat_list.append(self.emb_transform[k](tensor_feature))
301
302        # merge features
303        # print("Start merging features...")
304        all_item_emb = torch.cat(item_feat_list, dim=2)
305        all_item_emb = torch.relu(self.itemdnn(all_item_emb))
306        if include_user:
307            all_user_emb = torch.cat(user_feat_list, dim=2)
308            all_user_emb = torch.relu(self.userdnn(all_user_emb))
309            seqs_emb = all_item_emb + all_user_emb
310        else:
311            seqs_emb = all_item_emb
312        return seqs_emb
313
314    def log2feats(self, log_seqs, mask, seq_feature):
315        """
316        Args:
317            log_seqs: 序列ID
318            mask: token类型掩码，1表示item token，2表示user token
319            seq_feature: 序列特征list，每个元素为当前时刻的特征字典
320
321        Returns:
322            seqs_emb: 序列的Embedding，形状为 [batch_size, maxlen, hidden_units]
323        """
324        batch_size = log_seqs.shape[0]
325        maxlen = log_seqs.shape[1]
326        seqs = self.feat2emb(log_seqs, seq_feature, mask=mask, include_user=True)
327        seqs *= self.item_emb.embedding_dim**0.5
328        poss = torch.arange(1, maxlen + 1, device=self.dev).unsqueeze(0).expand(batch_size, -1).clone()
329        poss *= log_seqs != 0
330        seqs += self.pos_emb(poss)
331        seqs = self.emb_dropout(seqs)
332
333        maxlen = seqs.shape[1]
334        ones_matrix = torch.ones((maxlen, maxlen), dtype=torch.bool, device=self.dev)
335        attention_mask_tril = torch.tril(ones_matrix)
336        attention_mask_pad = (mask != 0).to(self.dev)
337        attention_mask = attention_mask_tril.unsqueeze(0) & attention_mask_pad.unsqueeze(1)
338
339        for i in range(len(self.attention_layers)):
340            if self.norm_first:
341                x = self.attention_layernorms[i](seqs)
342                mha_outputs, _ = self.attention_layers[i](x, x, x, attn_mask=attention_mask)
343                seqs = seqs + mha_outputs
344                seqs = seqs + self.forward_layers[i](self.forward_layernorms[i](seqs))
345            else:
346                mha_outputs, _ = self.attention_layers[i](seqs, seqs, seqs, attn_mask=attention_mask)
347                seqs = self.attention_layernorms[i](seqs + mha_outputs)
348                seqs = self.forward_layernorms[i](seqs + self.forward_layers[i](seqs))
349
350        log_feats = self.last_layernorm(seqs)
351
352        return log_feats
353
354    def forward(
355        self, user_item, pos_seqs, neg_seqs, mask, next_mask, seq_feature, pos_feature, neg_feature
356    ):
357        """
358        训练时调用，计算正负样本的logits
359
360        Args:
361            user_item: 用户序列ID
362            pos_seqs: 正样本序列ID
363            neg_seqs: 负样本序列ID
364            mask: token类型掩码，1表示item token，2表示user token
365            next_mask: 下一个token类型掩码，1表示item token，2表示user token
366            # next_action_type: 下一个token动作类型，0表示曝光，1表示点击
367            seq_feature: 序列特征list，每个元素为当前时刻的特征字典
368            pos_feature: 正样本特征list，每个元素为当前时刻的特征字典
369            neg_feature: 负样本特征list，每个元素为当前时刻的特征字典
370
371        Returns:
372            pos_logits: 正样本logits，形状为 [batch_size, maxlen]
373            neg_logits: 负样本logits，形状为 [batch_size, maxlen]
374        """
375        # print("===== Debug Info =====")
376        # print("Start log2feats...")
377        log_feats = self.log2feats(user_item, mask, seq_feature)
378        # print("End log2feats...")
379        loss_mask = (next_mask == 1).to(self.dev)
380
381        # print("Start feat2emb for pos...")
382        pos_embs = self.feat2emb(pos_seqs, pos_feature, include_user=False)
383        # print("End feat2emb for pos...")
384        # print("Start feat2emb for neg...")
385        neg_embs = self.feat2emb(neg_seqs, neg_feature, include_user=False)
386        # print("End feat2emb for neg...")
387
388        pos_logits = (log_feats * pos_embs).sum(dim=-1)
389        neg_logits = (log_feats * neg_embs).sum(dim=-1)
390        pos_logits = pos_logits * loss_mask
391        neg_logits = neg_logits * loss_mask
392
393        return pos_logits, neg_logits
394
395    def predict(self, log_seqs, seq_feature, mask):
396        """
397        计算用户序列的表征
398        Args:
399            log_seqs: 用户序列ID
400            seq_feature: 序列特征list，每个元素为当前时刻的特征字典
401            mask: token类型掩码，1表示item token，2表示user token
402        Returns:
403            final_feat: 用户序列的表征，形状为 [batch_size, hidden_units]
404        """
405        log_feats = self.log2feats(log_seqs, mask, seq_feature)
406
407        final_feat = log_feats[:, -1, :]
408
409        return final_feat
410
411    def save_item_emb(self, item_ids, retrieval_ids, feat_dict, save_path, batch_size=1024):
412        """
413        生成候选库item embedding，用于检索
414
415        Args:
416            item_ids: 候选item ID（re-id形式）
417            retrieval_ids: 候选item ID（检索ID，从0开始编号，检索脚本使用）
418            feat_dict: 训练集所有item特征字典，key为特征ID，value为特征值
419            save_path: 保存路径
420            batch_size: 批次大小
421        """
422        all_embs = []
423
424        for start_idx in tqdm(range(0, len(item_ids), batch_size), desc="Saving item embeddings"):
425            end_idx = min(start_idx + batch_size, len(item_ids))
426
427            item_seq = torch.tensor(item_ids[start_idx:end_idx], device=self.dev).unsqueeze(0)
428            batch_feat = []
429            for i in range(start_idx, end_idx):
430                batch_feat.append(feat_dict[i])
431
432            batch_feat = np.array(batch_feat, dtype=object)
433
434            batch_emb = self.feat2emb(item_seq, [batch_feat], include_user=False).squeeze(0)
435
436            all_embs.append(batch_emb.detach().cpu().numpy().astype(np.float32))
437
438        # 合并所有批次的结果并保存
439        final_ids = np.array(retrieval_ids, dtype=np.uint64).reshape(-1, 1)
440        final_embs = np.concatenate(all_embs, axis=0)
441        save_emb(final_embs, Path(save_path, 'embedding.fbin'))
442        save_emb(final_ids, Path(save_path, 'id.u64bin'))
taac_retrieval/objectives.py · L1–37
1"""Explicit next-event supervision policies and sampled contrastive losses."""
2
3import torch
4import torch.nn.functional as F
5
6
7def supervision_weights(actions, objective, exposure_weight=0.1):
8    if objective not in ['all_bce', 'weighted_bce', 'click_bce', 'click_infonce']:
9        raise ValueError(objective)
10    if exposure_weight < 0:
11        raise ValueError('Exposure weight must be nonnegative.')
12    weights = (actions == 2).float()
13    if objective == 'all_bce':
14        weights = weights + (actions == 1).float()
15    elif objective == 'weighted_bce':
16        weights = weights + (actions == 1).float() * exposure_weight
17    # Padding and unknown actions never provide supervised labels.
18    return weights
19
20
21def weighted_bce(positive, negative, weights):
22    pos = F.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(positive, torch.ones_like(positive), reduction='none')
23    neg = F.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(negative, torch.zeros_like(negative), reduction='none')
24    if negative.ndim == positive.ndim + 1:
25        neg = neg.mean(-1)
26    if neg.shape != pos.shape or weights.shape != pos.shape:
27        raise ValueError('Scores and supervision weights have incompatible shapes.')
28    if not (weights.sum() > 0):
29        raise ValueError('No supervised positions.')
30    return ((pos + neg) * weights).sum() / weights.sum()
31
32
33def sampled_info_nce(positive, negative, temperature=1.0):
34    if temperature <= 0 or negative.ndim != 2 or positive.ndim != 1:
35        raise ValueError('Expected [positions], [positions, negatives] scores and positive temperature.')
36    logits = torch.cat([positive.unsqueeze(-1), negative], dim=-1) / temperature
37    return F.cross_entropy(logits, torch.zeros(len(positive), dtype=torch.long, device=positive.device))

1"""Train matched baseline/action models; select by validation and test once."""
2
3import argparse
4import hashlib
5import json
6import os
7from pathlib import Path
8import random
9import time
10
11os.environ.setdefault('CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG', ':4096:8')
12
13import numpy as np
14import torch
15import torch.nn.functional as F
16from torch.utils.data import DataLoader
17
18from .data import PreparedData, SequenceDataset, sample_negatives
19from .metrics import evaluate, evaluate_popularity, to_device
20from .model import SequenceRetriever
21from .objectives import supervision_weights, weighted_bce, sampled_info_nce
22
23
24def seed_everything(seed):
25    random.seed(seed)
26    np.random.seed(seed)
27    torch.manual_seed(seed)
28    torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)
29    torch.set_num_threads(4)
30    torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark = False
31    torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic = True
32    torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = False
33    torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True)
34
35
36def initialization_hash(model):
37    digest = hashlib.sha256()
38    for name, parameter in model.named_parameters():
39        if not name.startswith('action_emb.'):
40            digest.update(name.encode())
41            digest.update(parameter.detach().numpy().tobytes())
42    return digest.hexdigest()
43
44
45def train(args):
46    output = Path(args.output).resolve()
47    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
48    if (output / 'result.json').exists():
49        raise FileExistsError('This run already has results; choose a new --output directory.')
50    seed_everything(args.seed)
51    data = PreparedData(args.cache)
52    if args.eval_indices:
53        data.set_eval_indices(np.load(args.eval_indices, allow_pickle=False))
54    if args.num_negatives < 1 or args.temperature <= 0:
55        raise ValueError('Negatives and temperature must be positive.')
56    config = vars(args).copy()
57    config.update(cache=str(data.root.resolve()), protocol=data.metadata,
58                  torch_version=torch.__version__, numpy_version=np.__version__,
59                  device_name=torch.cuda.get_device_name(args.device) if args.device.startswith('cuda') else 'CPU',
60                  selection_rule='best validation NDCG@10, then HR@10; never select using test',
61                  evaluation_cohort_sha256=hashlib.sha256(np.asarray(data.eval_indices, dtype=np.int64).tobytes()).hexdigest(),
62                  loss=dict(objective=args.objective, negatives=args.num_negatives,
63                            exposure_weight=args.exposure_weight, temperature=args.temperature,
64                            sampling='uniform train-visible items, excluding the user training prefix'))
65    model = SequenceRetriever(data, args.hidden, args.blocks, args.heads, args.dropout,
66                              use_actions=args.variant == 'actions')
67    config['shared_initialization_sha256'] = initialization_hash(model)
68    config['parameters'] = sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters())
69    (output / 'config.json').write_text(json.dumps(config, indent=2) + '\n')
70    model = model.to(args.device)
71    optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=args.lr, betas=(0.9, 0.98))
72    generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(args.seed)
73    negative_generator = torch.Generator(device=args.device).manual_seed(args.seed + 17)
74    loader = DataLoader(SequenceDataset(data), batch_size=args.batch_size, shuffle=True,
75                        num_workers=args.workers, pin_memory=args.device.startswith('cuda'), generator=generator)
76    negative_pool = torch.tensor(np.flatnonzero(data.train_counts), dtype=torch.long, device=args.device)
77    best = (-1.0, -1.0)
78    history, global_step = [], 0
79    started = time.monotonic()
80    with (output / 'events.jsonl').open('a', buffering=1) as event_file:
81        def emit(event):
82            event.update(elapsed_seconds=round(time.monotonic() - started, 3))
83            line = json.dumps(event)
84            print(line, flush=True)
85            event_file.write(line + '\n')
86
87        emit(dict(event='start', variant=args.variant, users=data.num_users, candidates=data.num_items,
88                  shared_initialization_sha256=config['shared_initialization_sha256']))
89        for epoch in range(1, args.epochs + 1):
90            model.train()
91            epoch_started = time.monotonic()
92            loss_sum, positions = 0.0, 0
93            for step, cpu_batch in enumerate(loader):
94                batch = to_device(cpu_batch, args.device)
95                optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
96                weights = supervision_weights(batch['target_actions'], args.objective, args.exposure_weight)
97                mask = (batch['positive'] != 0) & (weights > 0)
98                count = int(mask.sum())
99                if count == 0:
100                    continue
101                if args.num_negatives == 1 and args.objective != 'click_infonce':
102                    # Keep the original one-negative BCE computation and sampling intact.
103                    negative = sample_negatives(negative_pool, batch['seen'], batch['positive'].shape,
104                                                negative_generator)
105                    positive_logits, negative_logits = model(batch, negative)
106                    if args.objective == 'all_bce':
107                        loss = (F.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(positive_logits[mask],
108                                                                   torch.ones_like(positive_logits[mask])) +
109                                F.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(negative_logits[mask],
110                                                                   torch.zeros_like(negative_logits[mask])))
111                    else:
112                        loss = weighted_bce(positive_logits[mask], negative_logits[mask], weights[mask])
113                else:
114                    states = model.encode_history(batch['items'], batch['kinds'], batch['actions'], batch['user'])[mask]
115                    positive = batch['positive'][mask]
116                    row_indices = torch.where(mask)[0]
117                    negative = sample_negatives(negative_pool, batch['seen'][row_indices],
118                                                (count, args.num_negatives), negative_generator)
119                    positive_logits = (states * model.encode_items(positive)).sum(-1)
120                    negative_logits = torch.einsum('md,mkd->mk', states, model.encode_items(negative))
121                    loss = (sampled_info_nce(positive_logits, negative_logits, args.temperature)
122                            if args.objective == 'click_infonce' else
123                            weighted_bce(positive_logits, negative_logits, weights[mask]))
124                if not torch.isfinite(loss):
125                    raise FloatingPointError(f'Non-finite loss at epoch={epoch}, step={step}')
126                loss.backward()
127                grad_norm = torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 5.0, error_if_nonfinite=True)
128                optimizer.step()
129                loss_sum += float(loss.detach()) * count
130                positions += count
131                global_step += 1
132                if step % 100 == 0:
133                    emit(dict(event='train', epoch=epoch, step=step, global_step=global_step,
134                              loss=float(loss.detach()), grad_norm=float(grad_norm)))
135                if args.max_steps and global_step >= args.max_steps:
136                    break
137            training_seconds = time.monotonic() - epoch_started
138            validation, per_user = evaluate(model, data, 'val', args.device,
139                                            args.eval_batch_size, args.candidate_chunk)
140            np.savez_compressed(output / f'validation_epoch{epoch}.npz', **per_user)
141            row = dict(event='epoch', epoch=epoch, train_loss=loss_sum / max(positions, 1),
142                       supervised_positions=positions, training_seconds=training_seconds, validation=validation)
143            history.append(row)
144            emit(row)
145            score = validation['NDCG@10'], validation['HR@10']
146            if score > best:
147                best = score
148                torch.save(dict(model=model.state_dict(), epoch=epoch, config=vars(args),
149                                cache_signature=data.metadata['preparation_config'], validation=validation,
150                                evaluation_indices=torch.as_tensor(np.asarray(data.eval_indices).copy())),
151                           output / 'best.pt')
152            (output / 'history.json').write_text(json.dumps(history, indent=2) + '\n')
153            if args.max_steps and global_step >= args.max_steps:
154                break
155        checkpoint = torch.load(output / 'best.pt', map_location=args.device, weights_only=False)
156        model.load_state_dict(checkpoint['model'])
157        test, popularity = None, None
158        if not args.skip_test:
159            test, per_user = evaluate(model, data, 'test', args.device, args.eval_batch_size, args.candidate_chunk)
160            np.savez_compressed(output / 'test_predictions.npz', **per_user)
161            popularity, popularity_per_user = evaluate_popularity(data, 'test')
162            np.savez_compressed(output / 'popularity_test_predictions.npz', **popularity_per_user)
163        result = dict(variant=args.variant, seed=args.seed, objective=args.objective,
164                      num_negatives=args.num_negatives, best_epoch=checkpoint['epoch'],
165                      validation=checkpoint['validation'], test=test, popularity_test=popularity,
166                      global_steps=global_step, training_users=data.num_users, candidates=data.num_items,

1"""Exact full-catalog retrieval and explicit recommendation metrics."""

3import numpy as np
4import torch
5from torch.utils.data import DataLoader
6
7from .data import SequenceDataset
8
9
10def recommendation_metrics(predictions, targets):
11    predictions, targets = np.asarray(predictions), np.asarray(targets)
12    if predictions.ndim != 2 or len(predictions) != len(targets):
13        raise ValueError('Expected [users, k] predictions and [users] targets.')
14    matched = predictions == targets[:, None]
15    hits = matched.any(axis=1).astype(np.float64)
16    discounts = 1 / np.log2(np.arange(predictions.shape[1]) + 2)
17    ndcg = (matched * discounts).sum(axis=1)
18    return hits, ndcg
19
20
21def summarize(predictions, targets, rows, data):
22    hits, ndcg = recommendation_metrics(predictions, targets)
23    warm = data.train_counts[targets] > 0
24    result = {'HR@10': float(hits.mean()), 'NDCG@10': float(ndcg.mean()),
25              'users': len(targets), 'candidate_items': data.num_items,
26              'candidate_coverage': 1.0, 'filter_seen_items': True}
27    for name, selected in [('warm', warm), ('cold', ~warm)]:
28        result[name] = {'users': int(selected.sum()),
29                        'HR@10': float(hits[selected].mean()) if selected.any() else None,
30                        'NDCG@10': float(ndcg[selected].mean()) if selected.any() else None}
31    per_user = dict(rows=np.asarray(rows), targets=np.asarray(targets),
32                    predictions=np.asarray(predictions), hits=hits, ndcg=ndcg)
33    return result, per_user
34
35
36def to_device(batch, device):
37    return {key: value.to(device, non_blocking=True) for key, value in batch.items()}
38
39
40def exact_topk(queries, item_vectors, seen, k=10, chunk_size=32768):
41    """Streaming exact inner-product top-k; row 0 is padding and never returned."""
42    if len(item_vectors) <= k:
43        raise ValueError('The catalog must contain at least k nonpadding items.')
44    batch_size = len(queries)
45    scores = torch.full((batch_size, k), -torch.inf, device=queries.device)
46    ids = torch.zeros((batch_size, k), dtype=torch.long, device=queries.device)
47    for start in range(1, len(item_vectors), chunk_size):
48        end = min(start + chunk_size, len(item_vectors))
49        block = queries @ item_vectors[start:end].T
50        blocked_rows, blocked_cols = torch.where((seen >= start) & (seen < end))
51        block[blocked_rows, seen[blocked_rows, blocked_cols] - start] = -torch.inf
52        take = min(k, end - start)
53        block_scores, block_ids = block.topk(take, dim=1)
54        joined_scores = torch.cat([scores, block_scores], dim=1)
55        joined_ids = torch.cat([ids, block_ids + start], dim=1)
56        scores, order = joined_scores.topk(k, dim=1)
57        ids = joined_ids.gather(1, order)
58    if not torch.isfinite(scores).all():
59        raise ValueError('Not enough eligible finite-scoring candidates after history filtering.')
60    return ids
61
62
63@torch.inference_mode()
64def evaluate(model, data, split, device, batch_size=256, candidate_chunk=32768):
65    model.eval()
66    # The candidate universe is fixed by the cache, independent of model/seed.
67    vectors = torch.empty(data.num_items + 1, model.hidden, device=device)
68    for start in range(0, len(vectors), 8192):
69        end = min(start + 8192, len(vectors))
70        vectors[start:end] = model.encode_items(torch.arange(start, end, device=device))
71    if not torch.isfinite(vectors).all():
72        raise FloatingPointError('Non-finite candidate embeddings.')
73    loader = DataLoader(SequenceDataset(data, split), batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False,
74                        num_workers=0, pin_memory=str(device).startswith('cuda'))
75    predictions, targets, rows = [], [], []
76    for cpu_batch in loader:
77        batch = to_device(cpu_batch, device)
78        queries = model.predict(batch)
79        if not torch.isfinite(queries).all():
80            raise FloatingPointError('Non-finite user embeddings.')
81        if (batch['items'] == batch['target'].unsqueeze(1)).any():
82            raise AssertionError('Held-out target leaked into its history.')
83        topk = exact_topk(queries, vectors, batch['items'], chunk_size=candidate_chunk)
84        predictions.append(topk.cpu().numpy())
85        targets.append(cpu_batch['target'].numpy())
86        rows.append(cpu_batch['row'].numpy())
87    return summarize(np.concatenate(predictions), np.concatenate(targets), np.concatenate(rows), data)
88
89
90def evaluate_popularity(data, split):
91    # Stable tie-breaking by local item ID; only training-prefix counts are used.
92    ranking = np.lexsort((np.arange(len(data.train_counts)), -data.train_counts))
93    ranking = ranking[ranking != 0]
94    predictions, targets, rows = [], [], []
95    for sample in SequenceDataset(data, split):
96        seen = set(sample['items'])
97        chosen = []
98        for item in ranking:
99            if item not in seen:
100                chosen.append(item)
101                if len(chosen) == 10:
102                    break
103        predictions.append(chosen)
104        targets.append(sample['target'])
105        rows.append(sample['row'])
106    return summarize(np.asarray(predictions), np.asarray(targets), np.asarray(rows), data)

16def load_model(checkpoint_path, cache, device):
17    data = PreparedData(cache)
18    checkpoint = torch.load(checkpoint_path, map_location='cpu', weights_only=False)
19    if checkpoint['cache_signature'] != data.metadata['preparation_config']:
20        raise ValueError('Checkpoint cache signature does not match.')
21    if 'evaluation_indices' in checkpoint:
22        data.set_eval_indices(checkpoint['evaluation_indices'].numpy())
23    config = checkpoint['config']
24    model = SequenceRetriever(data, config['hidden'], config['blocks'], config['heads'], config['dropout'],
25                              use_actions=config['variant'] == 'actions')
26    model.load_state_dict(checkpoint['model'])
27    return model.to(device).eval(), data, checkpoint
28

30def evaluate_checkpoint(args):
31    output = Path(args.output)
32    if output.with_suffix('.json').exists():
33        raise FileExistsError('This evaluation already exists; do not silently overwrite a test result.')
34    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
35    torch.set_num_threads(4)
36    model, data, checkpoint = load_model(args.checkpoint, args.cache, args.device)
37    metrics, per_user = evaluate(model, data, args.split, args.device)
38    popularity, popularity_per_user = evaluate_popularity(data, args.split)
39    np.savez_compressed(output.with_suffix('.npz'), **per_user)
40    np.savez_compressed(output.parent / f'{output.name}_popularity.npz', **popularity_per_user)
41    digest = hashlib.sha256()
42    with open(args.checkpoint, 'rb') as handle:
43        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(8 * 1024 * 1024), b''):
44            digest.update(chunk)
45    result = dict(metrics=metrics, popularity=popularity, split=args.split,
46                  selected_epoch=checkpoint['epoch'], validation=checkpoint['validation'],
47                  checkpoint_sha256=digest.hexdigest(), checkpoint=str(Path(args.checkpoint).resolve()),
48                  training=checkpoint['config'],
49                  evaluation_cohort_sha256=hashlib.sha256(np.asarray(data.eval_indices, dtype=np.int64).tobytes()).hexdigest())
50    output.with_suffix('.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
51    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
52
53
54if __name__ == '__main__':
55    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
56    parser.add_argument('--checkpoint', required=True)
57    parser.add_argument('--cache', required=True)
58    parser.add_argument('--output', required=True, help='Output prefix without extension')
59    parser.add_argument('--split', choices=['val', 'test'], default='test')
60    parser.add_argument('--device', default='cuda:0')
61    evaluate_checkpoint(parser.parse_args())

1"""Faiss raw-inner-product retrieval with explicit ID mapping/history filtering."""
2
3import numpy as np
4
5
6def lift_database(vectors, radius_squared):
7    """Asymmetric MIPS-to-L2 lift; unlike normalization, it preserves IP order."""
8    norms = np.square(vectors.astype(np.float64)).sum(1)
9    if (norms > radius_squared + 1e-6).any():
10        raise ValueError('Lift radius is smaller than a database vector norm.')
11    extra = np.sqrt(np.maximum(radius_squared - norms, 0)).astype(np.float32)
12    return np.ascontiguousarray(np.column_stack([vectors, extra]), dtype=np.float32)
13
14
15class InnerProductFromL2:
16    """Query (q,0) against (v,sqrt(R²-||v||²)); convert distances back to IP."""
17    def __init__(self, index, radius_squared):
18        self.index, self.radius_squared = index, radius_squared
19        self.ntotal, self.d = index.ntotal, index.d - 1
20
21    def search(self, queries, k):
22        lifted = np.ascontiguousarray(np.column_stack([queries, np.zeros(len(queries), dtype=np.float32)]), dtype=np.float32)
23        distances, ids = self.index.search(lifted, k)
24        qnorm = np.square(queries.astype(np.float64)).sum(1)
25        scores = ((qnorm[:, None] + self.radius_squared - distances) / 2).astype(np.float32)
26        return scores, ids
27
28
29def filter_results(raw_ids, raw_scores, seen, k=10):
30    """Faiss row 0 represents local catalog ID 1, not padding ID 0."""
31    predictions = np.zeros((len(raw_ids), k), dtype=np.int64)
32    scores = np.empty((len(raw_ids), k), dtype=np.float32)
33    for row in range(len(raw_ids)):
34        blocked = set(np.asarray(seen[row]).tolist())
35        selected = set()
36        position = 0
37        for index_id, score in zip(raw_ids[row], raw_scores[row]):
38            item = int(index_id) + 1
39            if index_id < 0 or item in blocked or item in selected:
40                continue
41            predictions[row, position], scores[row, position] = item, score
42            selected.add(item)
43            position += 1
44            if position == k:
45                break
46        if position < k:
47            raise ValueError('Insufficient candidates after filtering. Increase overfetch or inspect the index.')
48    return predictions, scores
49
50
51def search_filtered(index, queries, seen, k=10):
52    queries = np.ascontiguousarray(queries, dtype=np.float32)
53    fetch = min(int(index.ntotal), k + int(np.count_nonzero(seen, axis=1).max()))
54    scores, ids = index.search(queries, fetch)
55    return filter_results(ids, scores, seen, k)
56
57
58def ann_recall(predictions, reference):
59    return float((predictions[:, :, None] == reference[:, None, :]).any(-1).mean())
60
61
62def select_configuration(rows, minimum_recall):
63    eligible = [row for row in rows if row['ANNRecall@10'] >= minimum_recall]
64    if not eligible:
65        raise ValueError('No HNSW configuration meets the predeclared validation recall threshold.')
66    return min(eligible, key=lambda row: (row['single_query_p95_ms'], row['efSearch']))

19def log(message):
20    print(time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'), message, flush=True)

23def build_index(vectors, kind, output, threads, m=32, ef_construction=100, geometry='raw_ip'):
24    faiss.omp_set_num_threads(threads)
25    started = time.perf_counter()
26    dimension = vectors.shape[1]
27    lifted = kind != 'flat' and geometry == 'mips_l2'
28    radius_squared = max(float(np.square(vectors[start:start+100000].astype(np.float64)).sum(1).max())
29                         for start in range(1, len(vectors), 100000)) if lifted else None
30    index = (faiss.IndexFlatIP(dimension) if kind == 'flat' else
31             faiss.IndexHNSWFlat(dimension + int(lifted), m,
32                                 faiss.METRIC_L2 if lifted else faiss.METRIC_INNER_PRODUCT))
33    if kind != 'flat':
34        index.hnsw.efConstruction = ef_construction
35    # Padding is not indexed. Returned Faiss IDs are mapped back with +1.
36    with threadpool_limits(limits=threads):
37        for start in range(1, len(vectors), 100000):
38            block = np.ascontiguousarray(vectors[start:start + 100000], dtype=np.float32)
39            index.add(lift_database(block, radius_squared) if lifted else block)
40            if kind != 'flat':
41                log(f'HNSW build: {index.ntotal:,}/{len(vectors)-1:,} items')
42    build_seconds = time.perf_counter() - started
43    faiss.write_index(index, str(output))
44    return index, dict(build_seconds=build_seconds, serialized_index_bytes=Path(output).stat().st_size,
45                       items=index.ntotal, dimension=dimension, index_dimension=index.d,
46                       geometry='mips_l2' if lifted else 'raw_ip', radius_squared=radius_squared)
47

49def latency(index, queries, seen, config):
50    threads = config['latency_threads']
51    faiss.omp_set_num_threads(threads)
52    times = []
53    rng = np.random.default_rng(719)
54    with threadpool_limits(limits=threads):
55        for row in range(min(config['warmup_queries'], len(queries))):
56            search_filtered(index, queries[row:row + 1], seen[row:row + 1])
57        for _ in range(config['latency_repeats']):
58            for row in rng.permutation(len(queries)):
59                start = time.perf_counter_ns()
60                search_filtered(index, queries[row:row + 1], seen[row:row + 1])
61                times.append((time.perf_counter_ns() - start) / 1e6)
62    # Batch throughput is a separate 8-thread workload, not the reciprocal of p95.
63    batch_times = []
64    faiss.omp_set_num_threads(8)
65    with threadpool_limits(limits=8):
66        search_filtered(index, queries[:32], seen[:32])
67        for _ in range(3):
68            start = time.perf_counter()
69            search_filtered(index, queries, seen)
70            batch_times.append(time.perf_counter() - start)
71    return dict(single_query_p50_ms=float(np.quantile(times, .5)),
72                single_query_p95_ms=float(np.quantile(times, .95)),
73                single_query_mean_ms=float(np.mean(times)), measured_single_queries=len(times),
74                single_query_threads=threads,
75                batch_qps_8_threads=float(len(queries) / np.median(batch_times)),
76                batch_queries=len(queries), latency_scope='CPU index search plus Python history filtering; warm cache; excludes encoder/network')

135        rows.append(row)
136        log(json.dumps(row))
137    (output / 'validation_sweep.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows, indent=2) + '\n')
138    chosen = select_configuration(rows, config['minimum_validation_ann_recall'])
139    # Lock index parameters using validation queries before opening test comparisons.
140    lock = dict(selected=chosen, criterion='smallest validation p95 among HNSW settings meeting ANNRecall threshold',
141                minimum_validation_ann_recall=config['minimum_validation_ann_recall'],
142                recommendation_targets_used_for_selection=False)
143    (output / 'index_selection.json').write_text(json.dumps(lock, indent=2) + '\n')
144    indexes['hnsw'].hnsw.efSearch = chosen['efSearch']
145    faiss.write_index(indexes['hnsw'], str(output / 'hnsw.faiss'))
146    test = dict(np.load(export_dir / 'test_queries.npz'))
147    test_count = min(config['latency_queries'], len(test['queries']))
148    test_indices = np.sort(np.random.default_rng(720).choice(len(test['queries']), test_count, replace=False))
149    tq, ts = test['queries'][test_indices], test['seen'][test_indices]
150    faiss.omp_set_num_threads(8)
151    with threadpool_limits(limits=8):
152        exact_test, exact_scores = search_filtered(indexes['flat'], tq, ts)
153        approximate, approximate_scores = search_filtered(searched_hnsw, tq, ts)
154    # Independent scalar NumPy scores validate raw-IP semantics and row IDs.
155    independently_scored = np.einsum('qd,qkd->qk', tq.astype(np.float64), vectors[exact_test].astype(np.float64))
156    if not np.allclose(independently_scored, exact_scores, rtol=2e-5, atol=2e-5):
157        raise AssertionError('Faiss raw inner-product scores/IDs do not match the exported vectors.')
158    result = dict(export=metadata, configuration=config, validation_configurations=rows,
159                  flat_validation_latency=flat_latency, selected=chosen,
160                  test=dict(queries=test_count, **{'ANNRecall@10': ann_recall(approximate, exact_test)},
161                            flat_recommendation=ranking_metrics(exact_test, test['targets'][test_indices]),
162                            hnsw_recommendation=ranking_metrics(approximate, test['targets'][test_indices])),
163                  test_flat_latency=latency(indexes['flat'], tq, ts, config),
164                  test_hnsw_latency=latency(searched_hnsw, tq, ts, config),
165                  build={name: json.loads((output / f'{name}_build.json').read_text()) for name in indexes},
166                  faiss_version=faiss.__version__, faiss_compile_options=faiss.get_compile_options(),
167                  platform=platform.platform(), cpu_count=os.cpu_count(),
168                  cpu_model=next((line.split(':', 1)[1].strip() for line in Path('/proc/cpuinfo').read_text().splitlines()
169                                  if line.startswith('model name')), 'unknown'),
170                  ids_and_inner_product_independently_verified=True,
171                  caveats=['Latency is warmed index-only CPU timing, not end-to-end production latency.',
172                           'Serialized bytes describe persisted index size, not peak resident memory.',
173                           'Multithreaded HNSW construction is not guaranteed bitwise reproducible.',
174                           'Strict ID-overlap recall can penalize alternative items tied at the top-k boundary.'])
175    np.savez_compressed(output / 'test_search.npz', rows=test['rows'][test_indices],
176                        exact=exact_test, approximate=approximate, targets=test['targets'][test_indices],
177                        validation_query_indices=val_indices, test_query_indices=test_indices)
178    (output / 'benchmark.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
179    log(f'Benchmark complete: {output / "benchmark.json"}')
180    return result

185    parser.add_argument('--export-dir', required=True)
186    parser.add_argument('--output', required=True)

19@torch.inference_mode()
20def recommend(args):
21    torch.set_num_threads(4)
22    faiss.omp_set_num_threads(1)
23    model, data, checkpoint = load_model(args.checkpoint, args.cache, args.device)
24    exported = json.loads((Path(args.export_dir) / 'metadata.json').read_text())
25    digest = hashlib.sha256()
26    with open(args.checkpoint, 'rb') as handle:
27        for block in iter(lambda: handle.read(8 * 1024 * 1024), b''):
28            digest.update(block)
29    if digest.hexdigest() != exported['checkpoint_sha256']:
30        raise ValueError('The query model differs from the indexed item model.')
31    indexed_identity = json.loads((Path(args.index_dir) / 'export_identity.json').read_text())
32    if indexed_identity['checkpoint_sha256'] != exported['checkpoint_sha256']:
33        raise ValueError('This index directory belongs to a different model.')
34    index = faiss.read_index(str(Path(args.index_dir) / 'hnsw.faiss'))
35    description = json.loads((Path(args.index_dir) / 'hnsw_build.json').read_text())
36    if description.get('geometry') == 'mips_l2':
37        index = InnerProductFromL2(index, description['radius_squared'])
38    if index.ntotal != data.num_items or index.d != model.hidden:
39        raise ValueError('Index dimension/catalog do not match the checkpoint.')
40    sample = SequenceDataset(data, args.split)[args.index]
41    batch = to_device({key: torch.as_tensor(value).unsqueeze(0) for key, value in sample.items()}, args.device)
42    # Warm up once; report request components separately from process startup.
43    model.predict(batch)
44    if args.device.startswith('cuda'):
45        torch.cuda.synchronize(args.device)
46    started = time.perf_counter()
47    query = model.predict(batch).cpu().numpy().astype(np.float32, copy=False)
48    encoded = time.perf_counter()
49    found, scores = search_filtered(index, query, sample['items'][None])
50    finished = time.perf_counter()
51    result = dict(user_rid=int(data.user_rids[sample['row']]),
52                  recommendations=[dict(item_oid=int(data.catalog_oids[item]), score=float(score))
53                                   for item, score in zip(found[0], scores[0])],
54                  timings_ms=dict(encoder_and_transfer=(encoded - started) * 1000,
55                                  index_and_history_filter=(finished - encoded) * 1000,
56                                  warm_request_total=(finished - started) * 1000),
57                  timing_note='One warmed local request; startup/model/index loading excluded; not a p95 measurement.',
58                  offline_target_oid=int(data.catalog_oids[sample['target']]))
59    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
60    return result
61
62
63if __name__ == '__main__':
64    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
65    parser.add_argument('--checkpoint', required=True)
66    parser.add_argument('--cache', required=True)
67    parser.add_argument('--export-dir', required=True)

70    parser.add_argument('--split', choices=['val', 'test'], default='test')
71    parser.add_argument('--index', type=int, default=0)
72    recommend(parser.parse_args())

3import argparse
4from datetime import datetime, timezone
5import hashlib
6import json
7from pathlib import Path
8import subprocess
9import sys
10import time
11
12import numpy as np
13
14DEVELOPMENT_VARIANTS = {
15    'weighted_bce': dict(objective='weighted_bce', num_negatives=1, variant='baseline'),
16    'click_bce': dict(objective='click_bce', num_negatives=1, variant='baseline'),
17    'click_bce64': dict(objective='click_bce', num_negatives=64, variant='baseline'),
18    'click_infonce64': dict(objective='click_infonce', num_negatives=64, variant='baseline'),
19    'click_infonce64_actions': dict(objective='click_infonce', num_negatives=64, variant='actions'),
20}
21BASELINE = dict(objective='all_bce', num_negatives=1, variant='baseline')
22
23
24def file_hash(path):
25    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
26
27
28def run_training_jobs(jobs, gpus, repo):
29    """Each job owns one GPU; completion is checked before scheduling another."""
30    pending = list(jobs)
31    running, failed = {}, []
32    while pending or running:
33        for gpu in gpus:
34            if gpu in running or not pending:
35                continue
36            output, arguments = pending.pop(0)
37            output = Path(output)
38            if (output / 'result.json').exists():
39                actual = json.loads((output / 'config.json').read_text())
40                for key, value in arguments.items():
41                    if key == 'cache':
42                        value = str(Path(value).resolve())
43                    if actual.get(key) != value:
44                        raise ValueError(f'Existing run {output} has a different {key}.')
45                print(f'Reusing completed run {output}', flush=True)
46                continue
47            command = [sys.executable, '-m', 'taac_retrieval.train', '--output', str(output), '--device', f'cuda:{gpu}']
48            for key, value in arguments.items():
49                option = '--' + key.replace('_', '-')
50                if isinstance(value, bool):
51                    if value:
52                        command.append(option)
53                else:
54                    command.extend([option, str(value)])
55            output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
56            with output.with_suffix('.log').open('w') as log:
57                process = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=repo, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
58            running[gpu] = process, output
59            print(f'Started GPU {gpu}: {output.name}, PID {process.pid}', flush=True)
60        for gpu, (process, output) in list(running.items()):
61            code = process.poll()
62            if code is not None:
63                print(f'Finished GPU {gpu}: {output.name}, exit={code}', flush=True)
64                if code:
65                    failed.append(str(output))
66                del running[gpu]
67        if running:
68            time.sleep(2)
69    if failed:
70        raise RuntimeError(f'Training jobs failed; inspect their logs: {failed}')
71
72
73def best_validation(folder):
74    history = json.loads((Path(folder) / 'history.json').read_text())
75    row = max(history, key=lambda r: (r['validation']['NDCG@10'], r['validation']['HR@10'], -r['epoch']))
76    return dict(epoch=row['epoch'], metrics=row['validation'])
77
78
79def lock_selection(root, baseline_root, config, report_dir):
80    """This function reads validation history only, including for old baselines."""
81    rows, fingerprints = [], {}
82    for name in ['baseline'] + list(DEVELOPMENT_VARIANTS):
83        runs = []
84        for seed in config['development_seeds']:
85            folder = Path(baseline_root) / f'baseline_seed{seed}' if name == 'baseline' else root / 'development' / f'{name}_seed{seed}'
86            best = best_validation(folder)
87            actual = json.loads((folder / 'config.json').read_text())
88            reference = json.loads((Path(baseline_root) / f'baseline_seed{seed}/config.json').read_text())
89            if actual['shared_initialization_sha256'] != reference['shared_initialization_sha256']:
90                raise AssertionError('Development ablations do not have matched initialization.')
91            for key in ['epochs', 'batch_size', 'hidden', 'blocks', 'heads', 'dropout', 'lr']:
92                if actual[key] != reference[key]:
93                    raise AssertionError(f'Development budget mismatch: {key}')
94            runs.append(dict(seed=seed, output=str(folder), **best))
95            fingerprints[str(folder / 'history.json')] = file_hash(folder / 'history.json')
96        rows.append(dict(name=name, runs=runs,
97                         validation_ndcg=float(np.mean([r['metrics']['NDCG@10'] for r in runs])),
98                         validation_hr=float(np.mean([r['metrics']['HR@10'] for r in runs]))))
99    ranking = sorted(rows, key=lambda r: (-r['validation_ndcg'], -r['validation_hr'], r['name']))
100    selected = ranking[0]['name']
101    candidate = selected if selected != 'baseline' else next(r['name'] for r in ranking if r['name'] != 'baseline')
102    settings = DEVELOPMENT_VARIANTS[candidate]
103    result = dict(selected_variant=selected, confirmation_candidate=candidate, confirmation_settings=settings,
104                  criterion=config['selection'], test_used_for_selection=False, ranking=ranking,
105                  history_sha256=fingerprints,
106                  scope='Development uses the old 100k-user cache; confirmation uses 300k sampled users and fresh test users.')
107    report_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
108    path = report_dir / 'model_selection.json'
109    if path.exists():
110        old = json.loads(path.read_text())
111        for key in ['selected_variant', 'confirmation_candidate', 'confirmation_settings', 'history_sha256']:
112            if old[key] != result[key]:
113                raise ValueError('The locked model selection has changed. Start a new study.')
114        return old
115    result['locked_at_utc'] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
116    path.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
117    print(f"Locked using validation only: {selected}; confirmation comparison: {candidate}", flush=True)
118    return result
119
120
121def main():
122    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
123    parser.add_argument('--root', default='artifacts/objective_study')
124    parser.add_argument('--baseline-root', default='artifacts/baseline')
125    parser.add_argument('--config', default='configs/objective_study.json')
126    parser.add_argument('--report-dir', default='reports/objective_study')
127    parser.add_argument('--gpus', default='0,1,2,3,4,5,6')
128    parser.add_argument('--stage', choices=['development', 'confirmation', 'models', 'test'], default='models')
129    args = parser.parse_args()
130    repo = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
131    root, baseline_root, reports = Path(args.root).resolve(), Path(args.baseline_root).resolve(), Path(args.report_dir).resolve()
132    config = json.loads(Path(args.config).read_text())
133    gpus = [int(value) for value in args.gpus.split(',')]
134    if not gpus or len(set(gpus)) != len(gpus):
135        raise ValueError('Unique GPU indices are required.')
136    common = {key: config[key] for key in ['epochs', 'batch_size', 'hidden', 'blocks', 'heads', 'dropout', 'lr', 'exposure_weight', 'temperature']}
137    common.update(workers=2, skip_test=True)
138    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
139    plan = dict(config=config, variants=DEVELOPMENT_VARIANTS,
140                negative_count_control='click_bce64 isolates the 64-negative budget from the contrastive objective',
141                confirmation_eval_indices=str(root / 'confirm_eval_indices.npy'))
142    plan_path = root / 'study_plan.json'
143    if plan_path.exists() and json.loads(plan_path.read_text()) != plan:
144        raise ValueError('Study plan changed; use a new output directory.')
145    plan_path.write_text(json.dumps(plan, indent=2) + '\n')
146    if args.stage in ['development', 'models']:
147        jobs = []
148        for name, settings in DEVELOPMENT_VARIANTS.items():
149            for seed in config['development_seeds']:
150                arguments = dict(common, cache=str(baseline_root / 'data'), seed=seed, **settings)
151                jobs.append((root / 'development' / f'{name}_seed{seed}', arguments))
152        run_training_jobs(jobs, gpus, repo)
153    selection = lock_selection(root, baseline_root, config, reports)
154    if args.stage in ['confirmation', 'models']:
155        if not (root / 'scale_data/metadata.json').exists() or not (root / 'confirm_eval_indices.npy').exists():
156            raise FileNotFoundError('Prepare the scale cache and freeze the fresh evaluation cohort first.')
157        jobs = []
158        for name, settings in [('baseline', BASELINE), ('selected', selection['confirmation_settings'])]:
159            for seed in config['confirmation_seeds']:
160                arguments = dict(common, cache=str(root / 'scale_data'), seed=seed,
161                                 eval_indices=str(root / 'confirm_eval_indices.npy'), **settings)
162                jobs.append((root / 'confirmation' / f'{name}_seed{seed}', arguments))
163        run_training_jobs(jobs, gpus, repo)
164    if args.stage == 'test':
165        evaluation_jobs = []
166        for name in ['baseline', 'selected']:
167            for seed in config['confirmation_seeds']:
168                folder = root / 'confirmation' / f'{name}_seed{seed}'
169                result = json.loads((folder / 'result.json').read_text())
170                if result['test'] is not None:
171                    raise AssertionError('Confirmation training must not have already consumed test labels.')
172                output = root / 'evaluation' / f'{name}_seed{seed}'
173                if output.with_suffix('.json').exists():
174                    continue
175                command = [sys.executable, '-m', 'taac_retrieval.evaluate_checkpoint', '--checkpoint', str(folder / 'best.pt'),
176                           '--cache', str(root / 'scale_data'), '--output', str(output)]
177                evaluation_jobs.append((command, output))
178        for offset in range(0, len(evaluation_jobs), len(gpus)):
179            jobs = []
180            for gpu, (command, output) in zip(gpus, evaluation_jobs[offset:offset+len(gpus)]):
181                command = command + ['--device', f'cuda:{gpu}']
182                output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
183                with output.with_suffix('.log').open('w') as log:
184                    process = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=repo, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
185                jobs.append(process)
186            codes = [p.wait() for p in jobs]
187            if any(codes):
188                raise RuntimeError(f'Test evaluation failed: {codes}')
189    print(f'Completed stage {args.stage}', flush=True)
190
191
192if __name__ == '__main__':
193    main()

3import argparse

6from pathlib import Path

12from .data import PreparedData, load_array
13from .metrics import recommendation_metrics
14from .study import file_hash
