24def feature_array(data, candidates, rows, changed, retrieval_z, ctr_z, base, group, device):
25    vector, attr, postings = vector_tables(data, group["fields"], device)
26    hist, action, ages = recent_context(data, rows, group["recent_events"])
27    early_clicks = np.load(Path(base["root"]) / "examples/stats_clicks.npy")
28    present = np.load(data.root / "mm_present.npy")
29    basic = np.stack((retrieval_z, ctr_z, np.log1p(data.train_counts[candidates]),
30                      np.log1p(early_clicks[candidates]), present[candidates]), -1)
31    side = []
32    for start in range(0, len(rows), 96):
33        s = slice(start, start + 96)
34        inputs = [torch.as_tensor(value[s], device=device) for value in (candidates, hist, action, ages)]
35        source = torch.as_tensor(changed[s], device=device)
36        extra = channel_features(*inputs, vector, attr, postings, source, group["click_bonus"])
37        side.append(extra.cpu().numpy())
38    x = np.concatenate((basic, np.concatenate(side)), -1).astype(np.float32)
39    assert x.shape == (*candidates.shape, len(FEATURES))
40    assert np.isfinite(x).all()
41    return x

44def score_candidate_lists(arrays_input, proposals, base, group, data, seed, device):
45    """Score the original and augmented lists using the same calibrated prior."""
46    rows = arrays_input["rows"]
47    frozen_path = Path("artifacts/ranking_content_v1/training") / f"mean_mlp_seed{seed}" / "best.pt"
48    ranker, rank_config, _ = load_content_ranker(frozen_path, device)
49    alpha = rank_config["blend"]["alpha"]
50    raw, raw_scores = arrays_input["candidates"], arrays_input["scores"]
51    history = np.stack([
52        history_clicks(data.items[row], data.actions[row], int(data.val_cut[row]), base["data"]["click_history"])
53        for row in rows
54    ])
55    ctr = score_mlp(ranker, raw, rows, history, device)
56    empty = np.zeros(raw.shape, dtype=bool)
57    original_r, _ = normalize_to_original(raw_scores, empty, [])
58    original_c, _ = normalize_to_original(ctr, empty, [])
59    original_score = (1-alpha)*original_r + alpha*original_c
60    original_sort = np.argsort(-original_score, axis=1, kind="stable")
61    original_order = np.take_along_axis(raw, original_sort, axis=1)
62    quota = [group["quotas"][g] for g in ("cold", "tail")]
63    merged = np.stack([
64        merge_candidates(retrieved, np.isin(retrieved, ranked[:group["protected_top"]]),
65                         data.train_counts, new, quota)
66        for retrieved, ranked, new in zip(raw, original_order, proposals)
67    ])
68    changed = merged != raw
69    added = np.zeros((len(rows), sum(quota)), dtype=raw.dtype)
70    per_user, _ = np.where(changed)
71    offset = np.cumsum(changed, 1)[changed] - 1
72    added[per_user, offset] = merged[changed]
73    vectors = np.load(Path(base["root"]) / f"features_seed{seed}" / "item_vectors.npy", mmap_mode="r")
74    added_recall = np.einsum("bd,bd->b", arrays_input["queries"][per_user], vectors[merged[changed]])
75    added_ctr = score_mlp(ranker, added, rows, history, device)[per_user, offset]
76    _, recall_z = normalize_to_original(raw_scores, changed, added_recall)
77    _, ctr_z = normalize_to_original(ctr, changed, added_ctr)
78    del ranker
79    fusion = (1-alpha)*recall_z + alpha*ctr_z
80    return merged, changed, fusion, recall_z, ctr_z, original_order
81
82
83def build(config, base, group, data, split, seed, device):
84    root = Path(config["output"]) / split
85    reference = root if split != "dev" else Path(group["outputs"]) / "confirm"
86    assert not (root / f"features_seed{seed}.json").exists()
87    source = reference / f"recall_seed{seed}.npz"
88    arrays_input = arrays(source)
89    cohort = selected_rows(config, split)
90    np.testing.assert_array_equal(arrays_input["rows"], cohort)
91    proposals = np.load(root / "proposals.npy" if split != "dev" else reference / "proposals.npy",
92                        allow_pickle=False)
93    if split == "dev":
94        proposals = proposals[:, 1]
95    assert proposals.shape[:2] == (len(cohort), 2)
96    n = len(cohort)
97    if split == "fit":
98        # Users absent from the union cannot yield a supervised row. Their labels never alter a candidate.
99        target = arrays_input["targets"]
100        possible = (arrays_input["candidates"] == target[:, None]).any(1)
101        possible |= (proposals == target[:, None, None]).any((1, 2))
102        arrays_input = {key:value[possible] for key,value in arrays_input.items()}
103        proposals = proposals[possible]
104    rows, target = arrays_input["rows"], arrays_input["targets"]
105    np.testing.assert_array_equal(target, data.items[rows, data.val_pos[rows]])
106    merged, changed, fusion, recall_z, ctr_z, original_order = score_candidate_lists(
107        arrays_input, proposals, base, group, data, seed, device)
108    frozen_path = Path("artifacts/ranking_content_v1/training") / f"mean_mlp_seed{seed}" / "best.pt"
109    label = merged == target[:, None]
110    keep = label.any(1) if split == "fit" else np.ones(len(rows), dtype=bool)
111    rows, target, merged, changed, fusion, recall_z, ctr_z, original_order = (
112        array[keep] for array in (rows, target, merged, changed, fusion, recall_z, ctr_z, original_order)
113    )
114    features = feature_array(data, merged, rows, changed, recall_z, ctr_z, base, group, device)
115    base_order = np.argsort(-fusion, kind="stable", axis=1)
116    fixed = np.take_along_axis(merged, base_order, axis=1)
117    if split == "dev":
118        known = arrays(reference / f"predictions_seed{seed}.npz")
119        np.testing.assert_array_equal(rows, known["rows"])
120        np.testing.assert_array_equal(np.sort(fixed, 1), np.sort(known["match"], 1))
121        np.testing.assert_array_equal(fixed[:, :10], known["match"][:, :10])
122    np.save(root / f"x_seed{seed}.npy", features)
123    np.savez(root / f"lists_seed{seed}.npz", rows=rows, targets=target, candidates=merged, prior=fusion,
124             original=original_order, fixed=fixed, added=changed)
125    positive = (merged == target[:, None]) & changed
126    write_new(root / f"features_seed{seed}.json", dict(
127        split=split, seed=seed, initially_available=n, n_rows=len(rows),
128        ranker_checkpoint_sha256=digest(frozen_path),
129        retrieval_candidates_sha256=digest(source),
130        features=list(FEATURES), basic_features=len(BASIC),
131        aux_positives=int(positive.sum()),
132        cold_targets=int((data.train_counts[target] == 0).sum()),
133        tail_targets=int(((data.train_counts[target] > 0)&(data.train_counts[target] <= 5)).sum()),
134        test_evaluated=False
135    ))
136    print(f"{split} seed{seed} features ready. {len(rows)} users, {int(positive.sum())} auxiliary positives.", flush=True)
137

141    p.add_argument("--config", default="configs/channel_rank.json")
142    p.add_argument("--device", default="cpu")
143    p.add_argument("--split", choices=("fit","dev","fresh"), required=True)
144    p.add_argument("--seed", type=int, required=True)
145    a = p.parse_args()

149    data = PreparedData(base["cache"])

113    def __len__(self):
114        return len(self.lists["rows"])
115
116    def inputs(self, index):
117        return (self.features[index], self.lookup[self.items[index]], self.history[index],
118                self.actions[index], self.ages[index])

121def content_lookup(data, device):
122    vector = torch.as_tensor(np.load(data.root / "item_mm81.npy"), device=device)
123    return F.normalize(vector, dim=-1)

126@torch.inference_mode()
127def updates(model, lists, step, keep_history=True):
128    model.eval()
129    scores = []
130    for start in range(0, len(lists), step):
131        inputs = lists.inputs(slice(start, start + step))
132        keep = None if keep_history else torch.zeros_like(inputs[3], dtype=torch.bool)
133        scores.append(model(*inputs, keep=keep).cpu().numpy())
134    return np.concatenate(scores)
135

137def make_model(config, variant, anchor, dim, device):
138    return HistoryRanker(variant, config["width"], config["heads"], config["history_length"],
139                         anchor.mean, anchor.std, dim).to(device)

142def fit(config, base, data, seed, device):
143    root, parent = Path(config["output"]), Path(base["output"])
144    out = root / f"development_seed{seed}.json"
145    if out.exists() or (root / "selection.json").exists():
146        raise FileExistsError(out)
147    check_plan(config, parent)
148    lookup = content_lookup(data, device)
149    args = (seed, data, lookup, config["history_length"], device)
150    train = CandidateLists(parent, "fit", *args)
151    dev = CandidateLists(parent, "dev", *args)
152    for split, lists in (("fit", train), ("dev", dev)):
153        declared = np.load(parent / split / "rows.npy")
154        if split == "dev":
155            np.testing.assert_array_equal(lists.lists["rows"], declared)
156        else:
157            assert np.isin(lists.lists["rows"], declared).all()
158    assert not np.intersect1d(train.lists["rows"], dev.lists["rows"]).size
159    anchor, scale = anchor_model(parent, seed, device)
160    batch_size = config["batch_size"]
161    train_base, dev_base = [
162        lists.lists["prior"] + scale * infer(anchor, lists.x, device, batch_size)
163        for lists in (train, dev)]
164    match = train.lists["candidates"] == train.lists["targets"][:, None]
165    assert (match.sum(1) == 1).all()
166    target = torch.as_tensor(match.argmax(1), device=device)
167    weights = torch.as_tensor(np.where(data.train_counts[train.lists["targets"]] <= 5,
168                                      config["rare_weight"], 1), device=device, dtype=torch.float32)
169    prior = torch.as_tensor(train_base, device=device)
170    baseline = ranks_for(dev.lists, dev_base)
171    reference = evaluate(dev.lists, baseline, data.train_counts)[0]
172    runs = []
173    for variant in VARIANTS:
174        torch.manual_seed(seed)
175        model = make_model(config, variant, anchor, lookup.shape[1], device)
176        opt = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=config["learning_rate"])
177        shuffle = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(seed)
178        folder = root / f"{variant}_seed{seed}"
179        folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
180        params = sum(parameter.numel() for parameter in model.parameters())
181        for epoch in range(1, config["epochs"] + 1):
182            started = time.perf_counter()
183            model.train()
184            losses = []
185            for batch in torch.randperm(len(train), generator=shuffle, device=device).split(batch_size):
186                opt.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
187                residual = model(*train.inputs(batch))
188                loss = list_loss(prior[batch], residual, target[batch], weights[batch],
189                                 config["residual_penalty"])
190                loss.backward()
191                torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 5.0)
192                opt.step()
193                losses.append(loss.detach())
194            loss = float(torch.stack(losses).mean().cpu())
195            assert np.isfinite(loss)
196            file = folder / f"epoch{epoch}.pt"
197            torch.save(model.state_dict(), file)
198            checkpoint = dict(path=str(file), sha256=digest(file))
199            correction = updates(model, dev, batch_size)
200            assert np.isfinite(correction).all()
201            for residual_scale in config["residual_scales"]:
202                prediction = ranks_for(dev.lists, dev_base + residual_scale * correction)
203                metric, _, changes = snapshot(dev.lists, baseline, prediction, data.train_counts)
204                runs.append(dict(variant=variant, epoch=epoch, scale=residual_scale, loss=loss,
205                                 params=params, checkpoint=checkpoint, metrics=metric, changes=changes))
206            current = metric["all"]
207            print(f"{seed} {variant} ep{epoch} loss {loss:.5f} HR@10 {current['Recall@10']:.4%} "
208                  f"NDCG {current['NDCG@10']:.6f} seconds {time.perf_counter() - started:.2f}", flush=True)
209    write_new(out, dict(seed=seed, train_lists=len(train), dev_users=len(dev), anchor=reference, runs=runs))
210

212def lock(config, base):
213    root = Path(config["output"])
214    check_plan(config, Path(base["output"]))
215    reports = [read(root / f"development_seed{seed}.json") for seed in config["seeds"]]
216    anchor = means([report["anchor"] for report in reports])
217    candidates = []
218    for same in zip(*(report["runs"] for report in reports), strict=True):
219        key = {p:same[0][p] for p in ("variant", "epoch", "scale", "params")}
220        assert all(all(run[p] == value for p,value in key.items()) for run in same)
221        aggregate = means([run["metrics"] for run in same])
222        guarded = aggregate["hr10"] >= anchor["hr10"] and aggregate["rare_top10_hits"] >= anchor["rare_top10_hits"]
223        candidates.append(dict(**key, **aggregate, guarded=guarded,
224            new_channel_top10=sum(run["changes"]["new_channel_top10"] for run in same),
225            checkpoints={str(seed):run["checkpoint"] for seed,run in zip(config["seeds"], same)}))
226    order = lambda arm: (arm["guarded"], arm["ndcg10"], arm["hr10"], -arm["epoch"], -arm["scale"])
227    arms = {v:max((arm for arm in candidates if arm["variant"] == v), key=order) for v in VARIANTS}
228    best = max(arms.values(), key=order)
229    diagnostic = best["variant"] if best["guarded"] and best["ndcg10"] > anchor["ndcg10"] else "dcn_v2"
230    write_new(root / "selection.json", dict(rule=RULE, anchor=anchor, development_choice=diagnostic,
231        arms=arms, all_configurations=candidates, plan_sha256=digest(root / "plan.json"),
232        fresh_rows_sha256=read(root / "cohorts.json")["cohorts"]["fresh"]["rows_sha256"]))
233    print(f"Development choice {diagnostic}; arms {arms}", flush=True)

236def load_history_ranker(config, arm, seed, anchor, dim, device):
237    ckpt = arm["checkpoints"][str(seed)]
238    assert digest(ckpt["path"]) == ckpt["sha256"]
239    model = make_model(config, arm["variant"], anchor, dim, device)
240    model.load_state_dict(torch.load(ckpt["path"], map_location=device, weights_only=True))
241    return model.eval()

244def timing(anchor, scale, models, values, device):
245    """Warm one-user model scoring on 500 already materialized candidates."""
246    synchronize = lambda: torch.cuda.synchronize(device) if str(device).startswith("cuda") else None
247    records = [values.inputs(slice(i, i + 1)) for i in range(96)]
248    timings = {"dcn_v2": [], **{key:[] for key in models}}
249    jobs = {"dcn_v2": None, **models}
250    for index, inputs in enumerate(records):
251        for name, model in jobs.items():
252            synchronize()
253            started = time.perf_counter()
254            scores = scale * anchor(inputs[0])
255            if model is not None:
256                scores = scores + model(*inputs)
257            synchronize()
258            if index >= 16:
259                timings[name].append(1000 * (time.perf_counter() - started))
260    return {name:{f"p{p}_ms":float(np.percentile(ms, p)) for p in (50, 95)}
261            for name,ms in timings.items()}
262

264@torch.inference_mode()
265def confirm(config, base, data, device):
266    parent, root = Path(base["output"]), Path(config["output"])
267    out = root / "confirmation.json"
268    if out.exists():
269        raise FileExistsError(out)
270    check_plan(config, parent)
271    selection = read(root / "selection.json")
272    assert digest(root / "plan.json") == selection["plan_sha256"]
273    rows = selected_rows(read(root / "candidate_config.json"), "fresh")
274    lookup = content_lookup(data, device)
275    reports, values = {}, {}
276    for seed in config["seeds"]:
277        anchor, scale = anchor_model(parent, seed, device)
278        args = (seed, data, lookup, config["history_length"], device)
279        fresh = CandidateLists(root, "fresh", *args)
280        np.testing.assert_array_equal(fresh.lists["rows"], rows)
281        dev = CandidateLists(parent, "dev", *args)
282        current_prior, dev_prior = [
283            lists.lists["prior"] + scale * infer(anchor, lists.x, device, config["batch_size"])
284            for lists in (fresh, dev)]
285        baseline = ranks_for(fresh.lists, current_prior)
286        metrics, local = evaluate(fresh.lists, baseline, data.train_counts)
287        reports[seed] = {"dcn_v2": dict(metrics=metrics)}
288        values[seed] = {"dcn_v2": local}
289        models = {}
290        for name, arm in selection["arms"].items():
291            model = load_history_ranker(config, arm, seed, anchor, lookup.shape[1], device)
292            models[name] = model
293            correction = updates(model, fresh, config["batch_size"])
294            prediction = ranks_for(fresh.lists, current_prior + arm["scale"] * correction)
295            metric, local, changes = snapshot(fresh.lists, baseline, prediction, data.train_counts)
296            masked_scores = updates(model, dev, config["batch_size"], keep_history=False)
297            masked_prediction = ranks_for(dev.lists, dev_prior + arm["scale"] * masked_scores)
298            masked = evaluate(dev.lists, masked_prediction, data.train_counts)[0]
299            reports[seed][name] = dict(metrics=metric, changes=changes, dev_no_history=masked["all"])
300            values[seed][name] = local
301        reports[seed]["timing"] = timing(anchor, scale, models, fresh, device)
302        np.savez(root / "fresh" / f"target_ranks_seed{seed}.npz", rows=rows,
303                 frequency=values[seed]["dcn_v2"]["target_train_frequency"],
304                 **{name:result["target_rank"] for name,result in values[seed].items()})
305        print(seed, {k:means([r["metrics"]]) for k,r in reports[seed].items() if k != "timing"}, flush=True)
306    variants = ("dcn_v2", *VARIANTS)
307    summary = {k:means([r[k]["metrics"] for r in reports.values()]) for k in variants}
308    frequency = values[config["seeds"][0]]["dcn_v2"]["target_train_frequency"]
309    buckets = dict(all=frequency >= 0, cold_0=frequency == 0, tail_1_5=(frequency >= 1) & (frequency <= 5))
310    comparisons = {}
311    for challenger, control in [(v, "dcn_v2") for v in VARIANTS] + [(VARIANTS[1], VARIANTS[0])]:
312        comparisons[f"{challenger}_vs_{control}"] = {
313            name:{metric:paired(np.stack([
314                v[challenger][metric][mask].astype(float) - v[control][metric][mask] for v in values.values()
315            ])) for metric in ("hits_at_10", "ndcg_at_10")}
316            for name,mask in buckets.items()}
317    environment = dict(device=device, device_name=torch.cuda.get_device_name(device)
318                       if str(device).startswith("cuda") else platform.processor(),
319                       torch=str(torch.__version__), torch_threads=torch.get_num_threads(),
320                       timing_scope="80 warmed per-user model calls x 500, synchronized, GPU shared if CUDA")
321    write_new(out, dict(users=len(rows), selection_sha256=digest(root / "selection.json"),
322        summary=summary, comparisons=comparisons, runs=reports, environment=environment, test_evaluated=False))
323    print(summary, flush=True)

326def main():
327    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
328    p.add_argument("--config", default="configs/sequence_rank.json")
329    p.add_argument("--stage", choices=("register", "fit", "lock", "confirm"), required=True)
330    p.add_argument("--seed", type=int)
331    p.add_argument("--device", default="cpu")
332    args = p.parse_args()
333    torch.set_num_threads(4)
334    config = read(args.config)
335    base = read(config["base_config"])
336    if args.stage == "lock":
337        lock(config, base)
338        return
339    data = PreparedData(read(base["ranking_config"])["cache"])
340    if args.stage == "register":
341        register(config, base, data)
342    elif args.stage == "fit":
343        if args.seed not in config["seeds"]:
344            p.error("Supply a configured seed for fit.")
345        fit(config, base, data, args.seed, args.device)
346    else:
347        confirm(config, base, data, args.device)

350if __name__ == "__main__":
351    main()

1"""Frozen content-only proposals for zero-click tail ads, with a fixed budget.
2
3Catalog IDs are the project's local IDs, not rows of the auxiliary index.
4No model parameter or buffer is changed; the main encoder remains independent.
5"""
6
7import numpy as np
8import torch
9from torch.nn import functional as F
10
11
12def eligible_tail_ids(counts, clickcounts):
13    """Return ascending local IDs with 1..5 training events and zero clicks."""
14    counts, clickcounts = np.asarray(counts), np.asarray(clickcounts)
15    if (counts.ndim != 1 or not counts.size or counts.shape != clickcounts.shape
16            or not np.issubdtype(counts.dtype, np.integer)
17            or not np.issubdtype(clickcounts.dtype, np.integer)
18            or (counts < 0).any() or (clickcounts < 0).any()
19            or (clickcounts > counts).any()):
20        raise ValueError('Counts must be aligned nonnegative training-event subsets.')
21    mask = (counts >= 1) & (counts <= 5) & (clickcounts == 0)
22    mask[0] = False
23    return np.flatnonzero(mask)
24

26@torch.inference_mode()
27def encode_tail_vectors(model, ids, score_mode='raw_ip'):
28    """Encode local IDs with zero candidate identity; return [items, hidden].
29
30    The learned attribute, 81 projection and fusion weights are retained. Cosine
31    mode normalizes these learned vectors, rather than re-normalizing raw 81.
32    """
33    if model.training or score_mode not in ('raw_ip', 'cosine'):
34        raise ValueError('Use an eval model and raw_ip or cosine scoring.')
35    device = model.item_emb.weight.device
36    ids = torch.as_tensor(ids, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
37    if ids.ndim != 1 or not len(ids) or ids.min() <= 0 or ids.max() >= len(model.item_id_lookup):
38        raise ValueError('Expected a nonempty vector of nonpadding local IDs.')
39    vectors = []
40    for chunk in ids.split(8192):
41        parts = [model.item_emb.weight.new_zeros((len(chunk), model.hidden))]
42        sparse = model.item_sparse[chunk]
43        parts.extend(model.sparse_emb[field](sparse[:, j]) for j, field in enumerate(model.item_fields))
44        parts.append(model.mm_projection(model.item_mm81[chunk]))
45        vector = torch.relu(model.item_dnn(torch.cat(parts, dim=-1)))
46        vectors.append(F.normalize(vector, dim=-1) if score_mode == 'cosine' else vector)
47    result = torch.cat(vectors)
48    if not torch.isfinite(result).all():
49        raise FloatingPointError('Auxiliary vectors must be finite.')
50    return result
51
52
53@torch.inference_mode()
54def retrieve_tail(queries, vectors, local_ids, seen, main, k=25, chunk_size=32768):
55    """Exact subset search, excluding seen and ALL main candidates before Top-K.
56
57    ``vectors`` is a torch [items, hidden] tensor. ``local_ids`` must be strictly
58    ascending and aligned with its rows. Return NumPy int64 [queries, k]; zeros
59    mean insufficient finite, unseen, novel proposals. Query normalization has
60    no effect on cosine ranking, so normalized vectors alone are sufficient.
61    """
62    queries = torch.as_tensor(queries, device=vectors.device, dtype=vectors.dtype)
63    ids = torch.as_tensor(local_ids, device=vectors.device, dtype=torch.long)
64    seen = torch.as_tensor(seen, device=vectors.device, dtype=torch.long)
65    main = torch.as_tensor(main, device=vectors.device, dtype=torch.long)
66    if (queries.ndim != 2 or vectors.ndim != 2 or queries.shape[1] != vectors.shape[1]
67            or ids.ndim != 1 or len(ids) != len(vectors) or not len(ids)
68            or ids[0] <= 0 or (ids[1:] <= ids[:-1]).any()
69            or seen.ndim != 2 or main.ndim != 2 or len(seen) != len(queries)
70            or len(main) != len(queries) or (seen < 0).any() or (main <= 0).any()
71            or k < 1 or chunk_size < 1):
72        raise ValueError('Invalid aligned queries, subset IDs, history, main list or budget.')
73    if not torch.isfinite(queries).all() or not torch.isfinite(vectors).all():
74        raise FloatingPointError('Search inputs must be finite.')
75    blocked = torch.cat((seen, main), dim=1)
76    mapped = torch.searchsorted(ids, blocked)
77    valid = (mapped < len(ids)) & (ids[mapped.clamp(max=len(ids) - 1)] == blocked)
78    blocked_rows, blocked_columns = torch.where(valid)
79    blocked_columns = mapped[blocked_rows, blocked_columns]
80    scores = vectors.new_full((len(queries), k), -torch.inf)
81    found = torch.zeros((len(queries), k), device=vectors.device, dtype=torch.long)
82    for start in range(0, len(ids), chunk_size):
83        stop = min(start + chunk_size, len(ids))
84        block = queries @ vectors[start:stop].T
85        selected = (blocked_columns >= start) & (blocked_columns < stop)
86        block[blocked_rows[selected], blocked_columns[selected] - start] = -torch.inf
87        values, positions = block.topk(min(k, stop - start), dim=1)
88        candidates = ids[start:stop][positions]
89        joined_scores = torch.cat((scores, values), dim=1)
90        joined_ids = torch.cat((found, candidates), dim=1)
91        scores, order = joined_scores.topk(k, dim=1)
92        found = joined_ids.gather(1, order)
93    return torch.where(torch.isfinite(scores), found, 0).cpu().numpy()
94
95
96def fuse_tail(main, proposals, counts, quota=5, protect_top=10):
97    """Return (fixed-width NumPy candidates, applied quota per query).
98
99    Callers supply only eligible-tail proposals. All main ads with frequency at
100    most five and the protected prefix survive; replacements remove the latest
101    unprotected nonrare positions and append genuinely new tail ads in order.
102    """
103    main, proposals, counts = np.asarray(main), np.asarray(proposals), np.asarray(counts)
104    if (main.ndim != 2 or not main.size or proposals.ndim != 2 or len(main) != len(proposals)
105            or counts.ndim != 1 or not np.issubdtype(main.dtype, np.integer)
106            or not np.issubdtype(proposals.dtype, np.integer)
107            or main.min() <= 0 or main.max() >= len(counts)
108            or proposals.min(initial=0) < 0 or proposals.max(initial=0) >= len(counts)
109            or not 0 <= protect_top <= main.shape[1] or not 0 <= quota <= main.shape[1]):
110        raise ValueError('Invalid catalog IDs, aligned candidate lists or fusion budget.')
111    if (np.diff(np.sort(main, axis=1), axis=1) == 0).any():
112        raise ValueError('Main candidates must be unique.')
113    valid = proposals > 0
114    if ((counts[proposals[valid]] < 1) | (counts[proposals[valid]] > 5)).any():
115        raise ValueError('Auxiliary proposals must be tail ads; zero is padding.')
116    fused, applied = main.copy(), np.zeros(len(main), dtype=np.int32)
117    for row, original in enumerate(main):
118        used, novel = set(map(int, original)), []
119        for item in proposals[row]:
120            if item and int(item) not in used:
121                novel.append(int(item))
122                used.add(int(item))
123        removable = [i for i in range(len(original) - 1, protect_top - 1, -1)
124                     if counts[original[i]] > 5]
125        take = min(quota, len(novel), len(removable))
126        removed = set(removable[:take])
127        fused[row] = [int(item) for i, item in enumerate(original) if i not in removed] + novel[:take]
128        applied[row] = take
129    return fused, applied

25def parameter_hash(model):
26    digest = hashlib.sha256()
27    for name, parameter in model.named_parameters():
28        digest.update(name.encode())
29        digest.update(parameter.detach().cpu().numpy().tobytes())
30    return digest.hexdigest()

33def summarize(main, fused, targets, counts, clicks):
34    before = (main == targets[:, None]).any(1)
35    after = (fused == targets[:, None]).any(1)
36    freq, support = counts[targets], clicks[targets]
37    masks = dict(all=np.ones(len(targets), bool), cold_0=freq == 0,
38                 tail_1_5=(freq >= 1) & (freq <= 5),
39                 zero_click_tail=(freq >= 1) & (freq <= 5) & (support == 0),
40                 clicked_tail=(freq >= 1) & (freq <= 5) & (support > 0),
41                 mid_6_50=(freq >= 6) & (freq <= 50), head_gt50=freq > 50)
42    return {name: dict(users=int(mask.sum()), baseline_hits=int(before[mask].sum()),
43                      hits=int(after[mask].sum()), gained=int((~before & after & mask).sum()),
44                      lost=int((before & ~after & mask).sum()),
45                      baseline_recall=float(before[mask].mean()), recall=float(after[mask].mean()))
46            for name, mask in masks.items()}

72            baseline = {key: a[key] for key in ['predictions', 'queries', 'seen', 'rows', 'targets']}
73        np.testing.assert_array_equal(baseline['rows'], rows)
74        np.testing.assert_array_equal(baseline['targets'], data.items[rows, data.val_pos[rows]])
75    else:
76        lock = read(root / 'confirmation_lock.json')
77        assert lock['cohort_sha256'] == array_sha(rows)
78        assert lock['checkpoints'] == identity['checkpoints']
79        _, baseline = evaluate_click_support(model, data, args.device, 128, 32768, k=500)
80    counts = np.asarray(data.train_counts)
81    clicks = np.load(identity['counts_file'], allow_pickle=False)
82    ids = eligible_tail_ids(counts, clicks)
83    raw_vectors = encode_tail_vectors(model, ids, 'raw_ip')
84    norms = raw_vectors.norm(dim=-1).cpu().numpy()
85    modes = plan['score_modes'] if args.phase == 'development' else [lock['score_mode']]
86    quotas = plan['quotas'] if args.phase == 'development' else [lock['quota']]
87    arrays = {key: baseline[key] for key in ['predictions', 'queries', 'seen', 'rows', 'targets']}
88    combinations, timing = {}, {}
89    for mode in modes:
90        vectors = raw_vectors if mode == 'raw_ip' else F.normalize(raw_vectors, dim=-1)
91        proposals, elapsed = [], []
92        for start in range(0, len(rows), 128):
93            stop = min(start + 128, len(rows))
94            queries = torch.as_tensor(baseline['queries'][start:stop], device=args.device)
95            if mode == 'cosine':
96                queries = F.normalize(queries, dim=-1)
97            if args.device.startswith('cuda'):
98                torch.cuda.synchronize(args.device)
99            began = time.monotonic()
100            proposals.append(retrieve_tail(queries, vectors, ids, baseline['seen'][start:stop],
101                baseline['predictions'][start:stop], k=plan['proposal_k']))
102            elapsed.append(time.monotonic() - began)
103        proposed = np.concatenate(proposals)
104        assert np.isin(proposed[proposed > 0], ids).all()
105        arrays[f'proposals_{mode}'] = proposed.astype(np.int32)
106        timing[mode] = dict(batch_size=128, batches=len(elapsed),
107            batch_search_seconds=sum(elapsed),
108            amortized_search_ms_per_query=1000 * sum(elapsed) / len(rows),
109            note='Exact GPU subset search including exclusions and CPU output copy; not single-query serving p95.')
110        for quota in quotas:
111            key = f'{mode}_q{quota}'
112            began = time.monotonic()
113            fused, applied = fuse_tail(baseline['predictions'], proposed, counts,
114                                      quota, plan['protected_top'])
115            np.testing.assert_array_equal(fused[:, :10], baseline['predictions'][:, :10])
116            arrays[key] = fused.astype(np.int32)
117            combinations[key] = dict(score_mode=mode, quota=quota,
118                groups=summarize(baseline['predictions'], fused, baseline['targets'], counts, clicks),
119                mean_replacements=float(applied.mean()), fusion_seconds=time.monotonic() - began)
120    assert parameter_hash(model) == initial_hash
121    result = dict(seed=args.seed, phase=args.phase, checkpoint=checkpoint, model_parameters_unchanged=True,
122        shared_parameter_sha256=initial_hash, auxiliary_pool_items=len(ids),
123        vector_norm_quantiles=np.quantile(norms, [0, .1, .5, .9, 1]).tolist(),
124        vector_zero_norm_count=int((norms == 0).sum()), combinations=combinations, timing=timing,
125        eligible_ids_sha256=array_sha(ids), source_manifest=read(root / 'source_manifest.json'))
126    np.savez_compressed(output.with_suffix('.npz'), **arrays)
127    freeze(output.with_suffix('.json'), result)
128    print(json.dumps(dict(event='worker_finished', phase=args.phase, seed=args.seed)), flush=True)

131class Study:
132    def __init__(self, args):
133        self.args, self.root = args, Path(args.root).resolve()
134        self.reports, self.plan = Path(args.report_dir).resolve(), read(args.config)
135        self.prior = REPO / 'artifacts/click_support_v1'
136        self.prior_identity = read(self.prior / 'cohorts/identity.json')
137        if (self.plan['score_modes'] != ['raw_ip', 'cosine'] or self.plan['quotas'] != [1, 5]
138                or self.plan['budget'] != 500 or self.plan['seeds'] != [2026, 2027, 2028]
139                or self.plan['protected_top'] != 10 or self.plan['proposal_k'] != 25
140                or self.plan['guards'] != dict(overall_retention=.99, minimum_positive_seeds=2)
141                or self.plan['eligibility'] != dict(min_events=1, max_events=5, training_clicks=0)):
142            raise ValueError('This runner implements only the four registered combinations.')
143
144    def prepare(self):
145        if any((REPO / f'artifacts/{name}/confirmation').exists() for name in
146               ['click_support_v1', 'candidate_regularization_v1']):
147            raise ValueError('The reused confirmation cohort has already been opened.')
148        freeze(self.root / 'plan.json', self.plan)
149        original = Path('/home/jyk/project/baseline_2025/artifacts')
150        identity = dict(self.prior_identity, checkpoints={}, references={})
151        identity['counts_file'] = identity['training_click_counts_file']
152        for seed in self.plan['seeds']:
153            path = original / f'objective_study/confirmation/selected_seed{seed}/best.pt'
154            reference = original / f'cold_start/diagnostics/click_seed{seed}.npz'
155            metadata = read(reference.with_suffix('.json'))
156            expected = identity['initial_checkpoints_sha256'][str(seed)]
157            assert sha(path) == metadata['checkpoint_sha256'] == expected
158            identity['checkpoints'][str(seed)] = dict(path=str(path), sha256=expected)
159            identity['references'][str(seed)] = dict(path=str(reference), sha256=sha(reference))
160        freeze(self.root / 'identity.json', identity)
161        for name in ['development', 'confirmation']:
162            values = np.load(self.prior / f'cohorts/{name}.npy', allow_pickle=False)
163            path = self.root / f'{name}.npy'
164            if path.exists():
165                np.testing.assert_array_equal(np.load(path, allow_pickle=False), values)
166            else:
167                np.save(path, values)
168        files = [Path(__file__), Path(self.args.config).resolve(), REPO / 'model.py',
169                 REPO / 'scripts/run_click_support.py',
170                 *[REPO / 'taac_retrieval' / name for name in ['tail_channel.py', 'click_support.py',
171                     'model.py', 'data.py', 'metrics.py', 'coverage.py', 'train.py', 'objectives.py',
172                     'evaluate_checkpoint.py']]]
173        freeze(self.root / 'source_manifest.json', {str(p.relative_to(REPO)): sha(p) for p in files})
174        self.verify()

176    def verify(self):
177        assert read(self.root / 'plan.json') == self.plan
178        for path, expected in read(self.root / 'source_manifest.json').items():
179            assert sha(REPO / path) == expected
180        identity = read(self.root / 'identity.json')
181        assert sha(identity['counts_file']) == identity['training_click_counts_sha256']
182        assert sha(Path(identity['cache']) / 'metadata.json') == identity['cache_metadata_sha256']
183        for name in ['development', 'confirmation']:
184            assert array_sha(np.load(self.root / f'{name}.npy', allow_pickle=False)) == identity[name + '_indices_sha256']

186    def evaluate(self, phase):
187        self.verify()
188        devices = self.args.gpus.split(',')
189        def run(pair):
190            index, seed = pair
191            if (self.root / f'{phase}/seed{seed}.json').exists():
192                return
193            log = self.root / f'{phase}/seed{seed}.log'
194            log.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
195            with log.open('a') as handle:
196                subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(Path(__file__)), '--worker', '--root', str(self.root),
197                    '--phase', phase, '--seed', str(seed), '--device', 'cuda:' + devices[index % len(devices)]],
198                    cwd=REPO, stdout=handle, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=True)
199        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=min(3, len(devices))) as pool:
200            list(pool.map(run, enumerate(self.plan['seeds'])))
201        return [read(self.root / f'{phase}/seed{seed}.json') for seed in self.plan['seeds']]
202
203    def aggregate(self, rows, key):
204        combinations = [row['combinations'][key] for row in rows]
205        groups = {group: {field: float(np.mean([r['groups'][group][field] for r in combinations]))
206                          for field in ['baseline_recall', 'recall', 'baseline_hits', 'hits', 'gained', 'lost']}
207                  for group in combinations[0]['groups']}
208        reasons = []
209        if groups['all']['recall'] < self.plan['guards']['overall_retention'] * groups['all']['baseline_recall']:
210            reasons.append('overall_retention')
211        for group in ['cold_0', 'clicked_tail']:
212            if groups[group]['recall'] < groups[group]['baseline_recall']:
213                reasons.append(group + '_decreased')
214        positive = sum(r['groups']['zero_click_tail']['hits'] > r['groups']['zero_click_tail']['baseline_hits'] for r in combinations)
215        if groups['zero_click_tail']['recall'] <= groups['zero_click_tail']['baseline_recall']:
216            reasons.append('no_zero_click_tail_gain')
217        if positive < self.plan['guards']['minimum_positive_seeds']:
218            reasons.append('insufficient_positive_seed_models')
219        return dict(key=key, score_mode=combinations[0]['score_mode'], quota=combinations[0]['quota'],
220                    groups=groups, passed=not reasons, reasons=reasons, positive_seed_models=positive)
221
222    def intervals(self, key):
223        values, targets = [], None
224        identity = read(self.root / 'identity.json')
225        counts = np.load(Path(identity['cache']) / 'train_counts.npy', allow_pickle=False)
226        clicks = np.load(identity['counts_file'], allow_pickle=False)
227        for seed in self.plan['seeds']:
228            with np.load(self.root / f'confirmation/seed{seed}.npz', allow_pickle=False) as a:
229                if targets is not None:
230                    np.testing.assert_array_equal(targets, a['targets'])
231                targets = a['targets']
232                values.append((a[key] == targets[:, None]).any(1).astype(float)
233                              - (a['predictions'] == targets[:, None]).any(1))
234        delta = np.stack(values)
235        freq = counts[targets]
236        masks = dict(all=np.ones(len(targets), bool), cold_0=freq == 0,
237                     tail_1_5=(freq >= 1) & (freq <= 5),
238                     zero_click_tail=(freq >= 1) & (freq <= 5) & (clicks[targets] == 0))
239        rng, result = np.random.default_rng(self.plan['bootstrap']['seed']), {}
240        for group, mask in masks.items():
241            selected = delta[:, mask]
242            sampled = [float(selected[rng.integers(0, 3, 3)][:, rng.integers(0, mask.sum(), mask.sum())].mean())
243                       for _ in range(self.plan['bootstrap']['replicates'])]
244            result[group] = dict(mean=float(selected.mean()), ci95=np.quantile(sampled, [.025, .975]).tolist(),
245                                 unique_users_with_gain=int((selected > 0).any(0).sum()), users=int(mask.sum()))
246        return result
247
248    def report(self, status, development, selected, confirmation=None, intervals=None):
249        self.reports.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
250        result = dict(status=status, plan=self.plan, development=development, selected=selected,
251                      confirmation=confirmation, paired_intervals=intervals,
252                      confirmation_targets_evaluated=confirmation is not None,
253                      original_main_replaced=False, source_manifest=read(self.root / 'source_manifest.json'))
254        freeze(self.reports / 'metrics.json', result)
255        lines = ['# 原序列召回＋零点击长尾补充通道', '', f'状态：`{status}`。没有训练或替换主模型。', '',
256                 '三份原主模型分别复用自己的用户查询；辅助候选去掉显式广告ID，保留原属性与81。',
257                 '先排除历史和原500候选，再从专用长尾目录检索；保护原Top-10及已有冷尾候选，总预算仍500。', '',
258                 '## 三模型开发复核', '',
259                 '| 评分/配额 | 整体Recall500 | 冷启动Recall500 | 长尾Recall500 | 零点击长尾Recall500 | 合格 |',
260                 '|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|']
261        for row in development:
262            g = row['groups']
263            lines.append(f'| {row["key"]} | {g["all"]["recall"]*100:.4f}% | {g["cold_0"]["recall"]*100:.4f}% | {g["tail_1_5"]["recall"]*100:.4f}% | {g["zero_click_tail"]["recall"]*100:.4f}% | {row["passed"]} |')
264        if confirmation is not None:
265            lines += ['', '## 一次新留出行为确认', '', f'冻结方案：`{selected["key"]}`；点估计门槛通过：{confirmation["passed"]}。', '',
266                      '| 分组 | 主通道Recall500 | 融合Recall500 | 平均新增/丢失目标数 |', '|---|---:|---:|---:|']
267            for group, g in confirmation['groups'].items():
268                lines.append(f'| {group} | {g["baseline_recall"]*100:.4f}% | {g["recall"]*100:.4f}% | {g["gained"]:.2f}/{g["lost"]:.2f} |')
269            lines += ['', '配对区间、逐模型结果和不同用户新增规模见metrics.json及本地产物；区间涉及三个固定模型和当前用户，不保证线上效果。']
270        lines += ['', '## 边界', '', '- 主Top-10和已有冷尾候选保持来自保护规则，不能称为这些指标的学习收益。',
271                  '- 只比较已登记raw_ip/cosine、配额1/5；确认后不改选。点估计门槛通过不等于统计稳定收益。',
272                  '- 仍是公共静态目录、逐用户截断，新确认用户的训练历史参加训练。',
273                  '- 辅助使用学得的属性/81表示，包含原高基数字段，不能称为纯文本语义模型。',
274                  f'- 本地产物：`{self.root}`。模型、完整候选和逐用户结果不进入Git。', '']
275        (self.reports / 'README.md').write_text('\n'.join(lines))
276        print(json.dumps(dict(event='finished', status=status, report=str(self.reports / 'README.md'))), flush=True)
277
278    def run(self):
279        self.prepare()
280        dev = self.evaluate('development')
281        rows = [self.aggregate(dev, f'{mode}_q{quota}') for mode in self.plan['score_modes'] for quota in self.plan['quotas']]
282        eligible = [r for r in rows if r['passed']]
283        freeze(self.root / 'development_selection.json', rows)
284        if not eligible:
285            self.report('stopped_after_development', rows, None)
286            return
287        selected = max(eligible, key=lambda r: (r['groups']['zero_click_tail']['recall'],
288            r['groups']['all']['recall'], -r['quota'], r['score_mode'] == 'raw_ip'))
289        lock = dict(score_mode=selected['score_mode'], quota=selected['quota'],
290                    cohort_sha256=array_sha(np.load(self.root / 'confirmation.npy', allow_pickle=False)),
291                    checkpoints=read(self.root / 'identity.json')['checkpoints'])
292        freeze(self.root / 'confirmation_lock.json', lock)
293        print(json.dumps(dict(event='locked', **lock)), flush=True)
294        confirmation = self.aggregate(self.evaluate('confirmation'), selected['key'])
295        self.report('completed_confirmation', rows, selected, confirmation, self.intervals(selected['key']))

21def read(path):
22    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())

25def sha(path):
26    value = hashlib.sha256()
27    with Path(path).open('rb') as handle:
28        for block in iter(lambda: handle.read(8 * 1024 * 1024), b''):
29            value.update(block)
30    return value.hexdigest()

33def array_sha(values):
34    return hashlib.sha256(np.asarray(values, dtype=np.int64).tobytes()).hexdigest()

37def masks(targets, counts, clicks):
38    frequency, support = counts[targets], clicks[targets]
39    return dict(all=np.ones(len(targets), dtype=bool), cold_0=frequency == 0,
40                tail_1_5=(frequency >= 1) & (frequency <= 5),
41                zero_click_tail=(frequency >= 1) & (frequency <= 5) & (support == 0),
42                clicked_tail=(frequency >= 1) & (frequency <= 5) & (support > 0),
43                mid_6_50=(frequency >= 6) & (frequency <= 50), head_gt50=frequency > 50)

46def group_summary(main, fused, targets, counts, clicks):
47    before, after = (main == targets[:, None]).any(1), (fused == targets[:, None]).any(1)
48    result = {}
49    for name, selected in masks(targets, counts, clicks).items():
50        assert selected.any(), f'Empty group needs explicit reporting: {name}'
51        result[name] = dict(users=int(selected.sum()), baseline_hits=int(before[selected].sum()),
52            hits=int(after[selected].sum()), gained=int((~before & after & selected).sum()),
53            lost=int((before & ~after & selected).sum()),
54            baseline_recall=float(before[selected].mean()), recall=float(after[selected].mean()))
55    return result

58def compare(actual, expected):
59    if isinstance(expected, dict):
60        for key, value in expected.items():
61            assert key in actual, key
62            compare(actual[key], value)
63    elif isinstance(expected, list):
64        assert len(actual) == len(expected)
65        for value, reference in zip(actual, expected):
66            compare(value, reference)
67    elif isinstance(expected, (float, np.floating)):
68        assert math.isfinite(actual) and math.isclose(actual, expected, rel_tol=1e-11, abs_tol=1e-12), (actual, expected)
69    else:
70        assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)

73def reconstruct(main, proposals, counts, quota, protected):
74    removable = [position for position in range(len(main) - 1, protected - 1, -1)
75                 if counts[main[position]] > 5]
76    used = set(map(int, main))
77    novel = []
78    for value in proposals:
79        item = int(value)
80        if item and item not in used:
81            novel.append(item)
82            used.add(item)
83    take = min(quota, len(novel), len(removable))
84    removed = set(removable[:take])
85    return np.asarray([int(value) for position, value in enumerate(main) if position not in removed]
86                      + novel[:take], dtype=main.dtype), take

92                     for field in ['baseline_recall', 'recall', 'baseline_hits', 'hits', 'gained', 'lost']}
93              for group in combinations[0]['groups']}
94    reasons = []
95    if groups['all']['recall'] < plan['guards']['overall_retention'] * groups['all']['baseline_recall']:
96        reasons.append('overall_retention')
97    for group in ['cold_0', 'clicked_tail']:

100    positive = sum(row['groups']['zero_click_tail']['hits'] > row['groups']['zero_click_tail']['baseline_hits']
101                   for row in combinations)
102    if groups['zero_click_tail']['recall'] <= groups['zero_click_tail']['baseline_recall']:
103        reasons.append('no_zero_click_tail_gain')
104    if positive < plan['guards']['minimum_positive_seeds']:

106    return dict(key=key, score_mode=combinations[0]['score_mode'], quota=combinations[0]['quota'],
107                groups=groups, passed=not reasons, reasons=reasons, positive_seed_models=positive)

110def verify(args):
111    root, reports = Path(args.root).resolve(), Path(args.report_dir).resolve()
112    plan, identity, manifest = read(root / 'plan.json'), read(root / 'identity.json'), read(root / 'source_manifest.json')
113    report = read(reports / 'metrics.json')
114    assert report['plan'] == plan and report['source_manifest'] == manifest
115    assert all(sha(REPO / path) == value for path, value in manifest.items())
116    cache = Path(identity['cache'])
117    assert sha(cache / 'metadata.json') == identity['cache_metadata_sha256']
118    assert sha(identity['counts_file']) == identity['training_click_counts_sha256']
119    counts = np.load(cache / 'train_counts.npy', allow_pickle=False)
120    clicks = np.load(identity['counts_file'], allow_pickle=False)
121    assert counts.shape == clicks.shape and (clicks >= 0).all() and (clicks <= counts).all()
122    eligible = np.flatnonzero((counts >= 1) & (counts <= 5) & (clicks == 0))
123    eligible = eligible[eligible > 0]
124    eligible_mask = np.zeros(len(counts), bool)
125    eligible_mask[eligible] = True
126    user_rids = np.load(cache / 'user_rids.npy', allow_pickle=False)
127    excluded = []
128    for source in identity['sources']:
129        assert sha(source['indices']) == source['indices_sha256']
130        assert sha(source['user_rids']) == source['user_rids_sha256']
131        rids = np.load(source['user_rids'], allow_pickle=False)
132        rows = np.load(source['indices'], allow_pickle=False)
133        excluded.extend(rids[rows].tolist())
134    excluded = np.unique(excluded)
135    development = np.load(root / 'development.npy', allow_pickle=False)
136    confirmation = np.load(root / 'confirmation.npy', allow_pickle=False)
137    assert not np.intersect1d(development, confirmation).size
138    assert not np.isin(user_rids[confirmation], excluded).any()
139    for name, rows in [('development', development), ('confirmation', confirmation)]:
140        assert array_sha(rows) == identity[name + '_indices_sha256']
141        assert array_sha(user_rids[rows]) == identity[name + '_rids_sha256']
142    old_rows = np.load(identity['sources'][2]['indices'], allow_pickle=False)
143    np.testing.assert_array_equal(development, old_rows)
144    parameter_hashes = {}
145    for seed, entry in identity['checkpoints'].items():
146        assert sha(entry['path']) == entry['sha256'] == identity['initial_checkpoints_sha256'][seed]
147        checkpoint = torch.load(entry['path'], map_location='cpu', weights_only=False)
148        value = hashlib.sha256()
149        # This model stores only trainable parameter tensors in its state_dict;
150        # feature buffers are nonpersistent. Ordering matches named_parameters.
151        for name, parameter in checkpoint['model'].items():
152            value.update(name.encode())
153            value.update(parameter.detach().cpu().numpy().tobytes())
154        parameter_hashes[int(seed)] = value.hexdigest()
155        del checkpoint
156    for seed, reference in identity['references'].items():
157        assert sha(reference['path']) == reference['sha256']
158        original = read(Path(reference['path']).with_suffix('.json'))
159        assert original['checkpoint_sha256'] == identity['checkpoints'][seed]['sha256']
160    selected = report['selected']
161    lock = read(root / 'confirmation_lock.json') if selected is not None else None
162    if lock:
163        assert lock['checkpoints'] == identity['checkpoints']
164        assert lock['cohort_sha256'] == array_sha(confirmation)
165        assert lock['score_mode'] == selected['score_mode'] and lock['quota'] == selected['quota']
166    else:
167        assert not (root / 'confirmation').exists()
168        assert not report['confirmation_targets_evaluated']
169    items = np.load(cache / 'items.npy', mmap_mode='r', allow_pickle=False)
170    cutoffs = np.load(cache / 'val_cut.npy', allow_pickle=False)
171    positions = np.load(cache / 'val_pos.npy', allow_pickle=False)
172    timestamps = np.load(cache / 'timestamps.npy', mmap_mode='r', allow_pickle=False)
173    phase_workers, saved_hit_deltas, saved_targets = {}, [], None
174    checked_fusions, checked_queries, phase_counts = 0, 0, {}
175    top10_equal = True
176    for phase in ['development', *(['confirmation'] if lock else [])]:
177        rows = development if phase == 'development' else confirmation
178        expected_targets = items[rows, positions[rows]]
179        expected_seen = np.zeros((len(rows), items.shape[1] + 1), dtype=np.int64)
180        for index, row in enumerate(rows):
181            cut = int(cutoffs[row])
182            expected_seen[index, -cut:] = items[row, :cut]
183            assert timestamps[row, cut - 1] < timestamps[row, positions[row]]
184        modes = plan['score_modes'] if phase == 'development' else [lock['score_mode']]
185        quotas = plan['quotas'] if phase == 'development' else [lock['quota']]
186        workers = []
187        for seed in plan['seeds']:
188            prefix = root / phase / f'seed{seed}'
189            worker = read(prefix.with_suffix('.json'))
190            assert worker['source_manifest'] == manifest
191            assert worker['model_parameters_unchanged'] and worker['shared_parameter_sha256'] == parameter_hashes[seed]
192            assert worker['checkpoint'] == identity['checkpoints'][str(seed)]
193            assert worker['auxiliary_pool_items'] == len(eligible)
194            assert worker['eligible_ids_sha256'] == array_sha(eligible)
195            if phase == 'confirmation':
196                assert prefix.with_suffix('.npz').stat().st_mtime >= (root / 'confirmation_lock.json').stat().st_mtime
197            with np.load(prefix.with_suffix('.npz'), allow_pickle=False) as source:
198                main, seen, targets = source['predictions'], source['seen'], source['targets']
199                np.testing.assert_array_equal(source['rows'], rows)
200                np.testing.assert_array_equal(targets, expected_targets)
201                np.testing.assert_array_equal(seen, expected_seen)
202                assert main.shape == (len(rows), 500) and (main > 0).all() and (main < len(counts)).all()
203                assert not (np.diff(np.sort(main, axis=1), axis=1) == 0).any()
204                assert np.isfinite(source['queries']).all() and source['queries'].shape == (len(rows), 32)
205                assert not (seen == targets[:, None]).any()
206                if phase == 'development':
207                    with np.load(identity['references'][str(seed)]['path'], allow_pickle=False) as old:
208                        for name in ['predictions', 'queries', 'seen', 'rows', 'targets']:
209                            np.testing.assert_array_equal(source[name], old[name])
210                for mode in modes:
211                    proposals = source[f'proposals_{mode}']
212                    assert proposals.shape == (len(rows), plan['proposal_k']) and (proposals >= 0).all()
213                    assert (proposals < len(counts)).all() and eligible_mask[proposals[proposals > 0]].all()
214                    for index, proposed in enumerate(proposals):
215                        valid = proposed[proposed > 0]
216                        assert len(np.unique(valid)) == len(valid)
217                        blocked = set(map(int, seen[index])) | set(map(int, main[index]))
218                        assert not blocked.intersection(map(int, valid))
219                    for quota in quotas:
220                        key = f'{mode}_q{quota}'
221                        fused = source[key]
222                        assert fused.shape == main.shape and (fused > 0).all() and (fused < len(counts)).all()
223                        assert not (np.diff(np.sort(fused, axis=1), axis=1) == 0).any()
224                        np.testing.assert_array_equal(fused[:, :10], main[:, :10])
225                        replaced = []
226                        for index in range(len(rows)):
227                            expected, applied = reconstruct(main[index], proposals[index], counts, quota, plan['protected_top'])
228                            np.testing.assert_array_equal(fused[index], expected)
229                            selected_ids = set(map(int, fused[index]))
230                            assert not selected_ids.intersection(set(map(int, seen[index])) - {0})
231                            assert set(map(int, main[index][counts[main[index]] <= 5])).issubset(selected_ids)
232                            assert all(eligible_mask[item] for item in selected_ids - set(map(int, main[index])))
233                            replaced.append(applied)
234                        groups = group_summary(main, fused, targets, counts, clicks)
235                        compare(worker['combinations'][key]['groups'], groups)
236                        compare(worker['combinations'][key]['mean_replacements'], float(np.mean(replaced)))
237                        assert groups['cold_0']['gained'] == groups['cold_0']['lost'] == 0
238                        assert groups['clicked_tail']['gained'] == groups['clicked_tail']['lost'] == 0
239                        assert groups['zero_click_tail']['lost'] == 0
240                        assert groups['mid_6_50']['gained'] == groups['head_gt50']['gained'] == 0
241                        # Equality of prefix IDs implies equal per-user HR/NDCG@10.
242                        discounts = 1 / np.log2(np.arange(10) + 2)
243                        np.testing.assert_array_equal((main[:, :10] == targets[:, None]).any(1),
244                                                      (fused[:, :10] == targets[:, None]).any(1))
245                        np.testing.assert_array_equal(((main[:, :10] == targets[:, None]) * discounts).sum(1),
246                                                      ((fused[:, :10] == targets[:, None]) * discounts).sum(1))
247                        checked_fusions += 1
248                if phase == 'confirmation':
249                    if saved_targets is not None:
250                        np.testing.assert_array_equal(saved_targets, targets)
251                    saved_targets = targets.copy()
252                    fused = source[selected['key']]
253                    saved_hit_deltas.append((fused == targets[:, None]).any(1).astype(float)
254                                            - (main == targets[:, None]).any(1).astype(float))
255            workers.append(worker)
256            checked_queries += len(rows)
257        phase_workers[phase] = workers
258        phase_counts[phase] = len(workers)
259    development_rows = [aggregate(phase_workers['development'], f'{mode}_q{quota}', plan)
260                        for mode in plan['score_modes'] for quota in plan['quotas']]
261    compare(report['development'], development_rows)
262    compare(read(root / 'development_selection.json'), development_rows)
263    eligible_rows = [row for row in development_rows if row['passed']]
264    expected_selection = max(eligible_rows, key=lambda row: (row['groups']['zero_click_tail']['recall'],
265        row['groups']['all']['recall'], -row['quota'], row['score_mode'] == 'raw_ip')) if eligible_rows else None
266    assert selected == expected_selection
267    interval_result = None
268    if lock:
269        compare(report['confirmation'], aggregate(phase_workers['confirmation'], selected['key'], plan))
270        rng = np.random.default_rng(plan['bootstrap']['seed'])
271        delta, interval_result = np.stack(saved_hit_deltas), {}
272        all_masks = masks(saved_targets, counts, clicks)
273        for group in ['all', 'cold_0', 'tail_1_5', 'zero_click_tail']:
274            chosen = delta[:, all_masks[group]]
275            bootstrap = []
276            for _ in range(plan['bootstrap']['replicates']):
277                seed_indices = rng.integers(0, 3, 3)
278                user_indices = rng.integers(0, chosen.shape[1], chosen.shape[1])
279                bootstrap.append(float(chosen[seed_indices][:, user_indices].mean()))
280            interval_result[group] = dict(mean=float(chosen.mean()),
281                ci95=np.quantile(bootstrap, [.025, .975]).tolist(), users=chosen.shape[1],
282                unique_users_with_gain=int((chosen > 0).any(0).sum()))
283        compare(report['paired_intervals'], interval_result)
284    test_log = Path(args.test_log).read_text()
285    match = re.search(r'Ran (\d+) tests', test_log)
286    assert match and '\nOK\n' in test_log
287    preflight = read(args.preflight)
288    assert preflight['unchanged_model_parameters'] and preflight['no_seen_or_main_overlap'] and preflight['protected_top10']
289    assert preflight['eligible_items'] == len(eligible) and preflight['candidate_budget'] == 500
290    assert preflight['source_sha256'] == sha(REPO / 'taac_retrieval/tail_channel.py')
291    result = dict(status=report['status'], frozen_source_files=len(manifest), source_manifest_matches=True,
292        original_checkpoint_files_verified=3, original_parameter_hashes_verified=True,
293        original_models_retrained=False, original_main_replaced=False,
294        eligible_zero_click_tail_pool=len(eligible), excluded_previous_user_rids=len(excluded),
295        development_users=len(development), confirmation_users=len(confirmation),
296        development_matches_old_cohort=True, development_confirmation_overlap=0,
297        confirmation_previous_evaluation_overlap=0, phase_worker_arrays_verified=phase_counts,
298        saved_query_rows_verified=checked_queries, fused_arrays_independently_reconstructed=checked_fusions,
299        fixed_500_unique_candidates=True, main_top10_and_per_user_hr_ndcg10_unchanged=top10_equal,
300        original_cold_tail_candidates_preserved=True, zero_click_tail_only_new_candidates=True,
301        novel_proposals_exclude_all_main500_and_visible_history=True,
302        all_per_model_groups_gainloss_and_aggregates_recomputed=True,
303        score_and_quota_selected_on_development_only=True,
304        confirmation_locked_before_saved_arrays=lock is not None,
305        confirmation_targets_evaluated=lock is not None,
306        paired_seed_user_bootstrap_independently_recomputed=lock is not None,
307        zero_click_tail_confirmation_interval=None if interval_result is None else interval_result['zero_click_tail'],
308        cpu_tests_passed=int(match.group(1)), gpu_16_user_preflight_passed=True,
309        verifier_source_sha256=sha(__file__))
310    reports.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
311    (reports / 'verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
312    (reports / 'acceptance_tests.log').write_text(test_log)
313    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
314    return result
315

317if __name__ == '__main__':
318    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
319    parser.add_argument('--root', default='artifacts/supplemental_tail_v1')
320    parser.add_argument('--report-dir', default='reports/supplemental_tail_study')
321    parser.add_argument('--test-log', default='artifacts/supplemental_tail_acceptance_tests.log')
322    parser.add_argument('--preflight', default='artifacts/supplemental_tail_preflight.json')
323    verify(parser.parse_args())

research/tail-recall/reports/click_support/README.md · L1–37
1# 按训练点击支持缩放候选广告ID
2
3实验状态：`stopped_after_pilot`。原主模型和索引没有替换。
4
5只改变候选ID输入的缩放系数；历史ID不缩放。保持原用户编码器结构，全部共享参数正常微调，因此用户向量不是固定的。
6同一已有checkpoint出发、重置Adam、微调两轮；loss与负样本规则不变。无新通道、网络层或训练参数。
7
8## 单种子开发结果（seed2026）
9
10| 方案 | epoch | 全体Recall@500 | 冷启动Recall@500 | 长尾Recall@500 | NDCG@10 | 通过 |
11|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
12| 原主模型 | 0 | 23.1200% | 8.4977% | 0.5279% | 0.015672 | 对照 |
13| 正常微调对照 | 2 | 23.6000% | 6.5250% | 1.0558% | 0.014715 | 对照 |
14| 候选ID scale=0.5 | 1 | 25.1300% | 2.5797% | 1.8854% | 0.015073 | False |
15| 候选ID scale=0.5 | 2 | 24.7000% | 2.1244% | 1.8100% | 0.014809 | False |
16| 候选ID scale=0 | 1 | 25.4500% | 0.3035% | 1.5837% | 0.015232 | False |
17| 候选ID scale=0 | 2 | 25.4300% | 0.1517% | 1.4329% | 0.015034 | False |
18| 候选ID scale=0.75 | 1 | 24.3800% | 5.6146% | 0.9050% | 0.015367 | False |
19| 候选ID scale=0.75 | 2 | 24.5100% | 4.0971% | 1.2066% | 0.014878 | False |
20
21## 决策和边界
22
23- 同时对比原模型与正常微调对照，避免把额外训练的收益误认为门控收益。
24- 全体Recall@500至少保留99%，NDCG@10至少保留95%，冷启动与长尾均不下降，冷尾宏平均严格改善。
25- Pilot锁定scale和epoch后才训练另外两个种子；未通过复核就停止，不再搜索新参数。
26- 初始三组无合格改善但存在长尾增益时，仅允许一次预定scale0.75；其他结构保持不变。
27- 新确认集是否评估：False。不把开发结果表述为新确认收益。
28- 新确认队列排除已知评估过的31574个RID；用户训练前缀仍参加训练，不是训练未见新用户实验。
29- 仍是公共静态目录、逐用户时间截断，不是统一时间生产回放。
30- 本研究没有自动替换原主分支、checkpoint或Faiss索引；仅在实际通过后讨论最小集成。
31
32## 复现
33
34入口：`scripts/run_click_support.py --help`。配置：`configs/click_support.json`。
35本地产物：`/home/jyk/project/baseline_2025_click_support/artifacts/click_support_v1`。每轮权重、逐用户Top-500、完整训练日志和源码摘要均保留。
36
37逐目标命中、候选分布和零点击长尾拆分见[失败分析](analysis.md)；产物独立核对见[verification.json](verification.json)。
research/tail-recall/reports/candidate_regularization/README.md · L1–29
1# 仅对候选广告ID做训练遮蔽
2
3状态：`stopped_after_pilot`。原主模型没有替换。
4
5这是查看点击支持门控失败后独立登记的后续实验，不改写前一轮结果。
6只试p=0.5：正负候选按广告身份共享随机掩码，历史ID保持完整；推断时关闭遮蔽、使用完整ID。
7复用同一正常微调对照，新增网络层、通道和参数均为0。
8
9## seed2026开发对照
10
11| 方案 | epoch | 整体Recall@500 | 冷启动Recall@500 | 长尾Recall@500 | NDCG@10 | 通过 |
12|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
13| 原模型 | 0 | 23.1200% | 8.4977% | 0.5279% | 0.015672 | 对照 |
14| 正常微调 | 2 | 23.6000% | 6.5250% | 1.0558% | 0.014715 | 对照 |
15| 候选ID遮蔽p0.5 | 1 | 25.0200% | 4.0971% | 1.1312% | 0.015930 | False |
16| 候选ID遮蔽p0.5 | 2 | 24.8600% | 3.4901% | 1.5083% | 0.015314 | False |
17
18## 边界
19
20- 使用旧10000人开发队列；通过后才锁定epoch并复核另外两个种子，再决定是否打开新确认目标。
21- 相同checkpoint、两轮、Adam重置、lr0.0003、点击InfoNCE-64；仅训练候选ID遮蔽不同。
22- 每批一个独立Generator(seed+73)掩码，不消费普通Dropout/负采样/打乱随机流；不做倒置缩放。
23- 原用户结构与历史信息保留，全部权重仍参与训练，不是固定q。
24- 新确认目标是否评估：False。没有通过就停止，不再搜索p或添加模块。
25- 公共静态目录、逐用户截断仍然是限制，新确认用户的训练前缀仍参加训练。
26
27本地产物：`/home/jyk/project/baseline_2025_click_support/artifacts/candidate_regularization_v1`。复现入口：`scripts/run_candidate_regularization.py --help`。
28
29长尾增益来自哪些目标、冷目标新增与丢失见[分桶分析](analysis.md)；52项测试和完整开发产物核对见[verification.json](verification.json)。
能独立回答本章问题后，再标记完成。
